title: 第一章：六岁时的蟒蛇画与大人们的偏见
titleEn: Chapter 1: The Drawing of the Boa Constrictor & Adult Blindness

sentences.chinese: 我六岁的时候，在一本书中看到了一幅精彩的插画，画的是一条蟒蛇正在吞食一只野兽。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ liù suì de shí hòu ， zài yī běn shū zhōng kàn dào le yī fú jīng cǎi de chā huà ， huà de shì yī tiáo mǎng shé zhèng zài tūn shí yī zhǐ yě shòu 。
sentences.english: When I was six years old, I saw a magnificent picture in a book, depicting a boa constrictor swallowing a wild beast.

sentences.chinese: 书上写着：“蟒蛇把猎物整个吞下去，不用咀嚼；然后它们动弹不得，睡上整整六个月来消化。”
sentences.pinyin: shū shàng xiě zhuó ： “ mǎng shé bǎ liè wù zhěng gè tūn xià qù ， bù yòng jǔ jué ； rán hòu tā mén dòng tán bù dé ， shuì shàng zhěng zhěng liù gè yuè lái xiāo huà 。 ”
sentences.english: The book said: "Boa constrictors swallow their prey whole, without chewing; then they cannot move and sleep for six months to digest."

sentences.chinese: 我想了很久，用彩色铅笔画出了我的第一幅作品：那不是一顶帽子，而是一条正在消化大象的巨蟒。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ ， yòng cǎi sè qiān bǐ huà chū le wǒ de dì yī fú zuò pǐn ： nà bù shì yī dǐng mào zǐ ， ér shì yī tiáo zhèng zài xiāo huà dà xiàng de jù mǎng 。
sentences.english: I pondered deeply, and with a colored pencil drew my first artwork: it was not a hat, but a boa constrictor digesting an elephant.

sentences.chinese: 我把杰作拿给大人们看，问他们害不害怕。他们却回答：“一顶帽子有什么好怕的？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎ jié zuò ná gěi dà rén mén kàn ， wèn tā mén hài bù hài pà 。 tā mén què huí dá ： “ yī dǐng mào zǐ yǒu shén me hǎo pà de ？ ”
sentences.english: I showed my masterpiece to the grown-ups and asked if it frightened them. They answered: "Why should anyone be frightened by a hat?"

sentences.chinese: 为了让大人看明白，我又画了第二幅画，把巨蟒肚子里面切开，露出了里面的大象。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le ràng dà rén kàn míng bái ， wǒ yòu huà le dì èr fú huà ， bǎ jù mǎng dù zǐ lǐ miàn qiē kāi ， lòu chū le lǐ miàn de dà xiàng 。
sentences.english: So that grown-ups could understand, I drew a second picture, showing the interior of the boa constrictor with the elephant inside.

sentences.chinese: 大人们劝我把这些画放在一边，专心去学地理、历史、算术和语法。
sentences.pinyin: dà rén mén quàn wǒ bǎ zhè xiē huà fàng zài yī biān ， zhuān xīn qù xué dì lǐ 、 lì shǐ 、 suàn shù hé yǔ fǎ 。
sentences.english: The grown-ups advised me to lay aside drawings of snakes and devote myself instead to geography, history, arithmetic, and grammar.

sentences.chinese: 就这样，我在六岁时放弃了成为一名画家的伟大志向。大人们自己永远什么也弄不懂，总要小孩子反复解释，真是累人。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng ， wǒ zài liù suì shí fàng qì le chéng wéi yī míng huà jiā de wěi dà zhì xiàng 。 dà rén mén zì jǐ yǒng yuǎn shén me yě nòng bù dǒng ， zǒng yào xiǎo hái zǐ fǎn fù jiě shì ， zhēn shì léi rén 。
sentences.english: Thus, at the age of six, I gave up a magnificent career as a painter. Grown-ups never understand anything by themselves, and it is exhausting for children to always explain.

title: 第二章：撒哈拉沙漠坠机与“请给我画一只羊”
titleEn: Chapter 2: Crash in the Sahara & "Please Draw Me a Sheep"

sentences.chinese: 六年前，我的飞机在茫茫无际的撒哈拉沙漠中发生了故障。我的发动机里有些东西碎了。
sentences.pinyin: liù nián qián ， wǒ de fēi jī zài máng máng wú jì de sā hā lā shā mò zhōng fā shēng le gù zhàng 。 wǒ de fā dòng jī lǐ yǒu xiē dōng xī suì le 。
sentences.english: Six years ago, my plane broke down in the boundless Sahara desert. Something had broken in my engine.

sentences.chinese: 由于身边没有机械师，也没有乘客，我只能孤身一人尝试进行艰难的维修，饮用水只够维持八天。
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú shēn biān méi yǒu jī xiè shī ， yě méi yǒu chéng kè ， wǒ zhǐ néng gū shēn yī rén cháng shì jìn xíng jiān nán de wéi xiū ， yǐn yòng shuǐ zhǐ gòu wéi chí bā tiān 。
sentences.english: With neither mechanic nor passengers, I prepared to attempt a difficult repair alone, with barely eight days of drinking water.

sentences.chinese: 第一天晚上，我在远离人烟一千英里的沙漠上睡着了，比汪洋大海中遭遇海难的水手还要孤独。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī tiān wǎn shàng ， wǒ zài yuǎn lí rén yān yī qiān yīng lǐ de shā mò shàng shuì zhuó le ， bǐ wāng yáng dà hǎi zhōng zāo yù hǎi nán de shuǐ shǒu hái yào gū dú 。
sentences.english: The first night, I went to sleep on the sand, a thousand miles from any human habitation, more isolated than a shipwrecked sailor on an ocean.

sentences.chinese: 拂晓时分，一个奇怪的小声音唤醒了我：“请……请给我画一只羊吧！”
sentences.pinyin: fú xiǎo shí fēn ， yī gè qí guài de xiǎo shēng yīn huàn xǐng le wǒ ： “ qǐng … … qǐng gěi wǒ huà yī zhǐ yáng bā ！ ”
sentences.english: At daybreak, a strange little voice woke me: "Please... please draw me a sheep!"

sentences.chinese: 我猛地跳了起来，揉了揉眼睛。我看到一个非同寻常的小人儿，正神情严肃地审视着我。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ měng dì tiào le qǐ lái ， róu le róu yǎn jīng 。 wǒ kàn dào yī gè fēi tóng xún cháng de xiǎo rén ér ， zhèng shén qíng yán sù dì shěn shì zhuó wǒ 。
sentences.english: I leaped to my feet, rubbing my eyes. I saw an extraordinary little fellow standing there, examining me with solemn gravity.

sentences.chinese: 他既不像迷了路，也不像饥渴交加。他就是一个来自异星的金色头发的小王子。
sentences.pinyin: tā jì bù xiàng mí le lù ， yě bù xiàng jī kě jiāo jiā 。 tā jiù shì yī gè lái zì yì xīng de jīn sè tóu fā de xiǎo wáng zǐ 。
sentences.english: He did not appear lost, nor dying of hunger or thirst. He was simply a golden-haired little prince from another world.

sentences.chinese: 我画了一只生病的羊，他不要；又画了一只有角的公羊，他也摇头。最后我画了一个箱子：“你要的羊就在盒子里。”小王子的脸上顿时绽放出灿烂的笑容。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huà le yī zhǐ shēng bìng de yáng ， tā bù yào ； yòu huà le yī zhǐ yǒu jiǎo de gōng yáng ， tā yě yáo tóu 。 zuì hòu wǒ huà le yī gè xiāng zǐ ： “ nǐ yào de yáng jiù zài hé zǐ lǐ 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ de liǎn shàng dùn shí zhàn fàng chū càn làn de xiào róng 。
sentences.english: I drew a sickly sheep, which he rejected; then a horned ram, which he also shook his head at. Finally, I drew a wooden box: "The sheep you asked for is inside." The little prince beamed with a radiant smile.

title: 第三章：小王子的来历与微小的B612星球
titleEn: Chapter 3: The Origins of the Prince & His Tiny Home

sentences.chinese: 我花了好长一段时间才弄清楚他究竟是从哪里来的。小王子向我提出了很多问题，却似乎从不听我的回答。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huā le hǎo cháng yī duàn shí jiān cái nòng qīng chǔ tā jiū jìng shì cóng nǎ lǐ lái de 。 xiǎo wáng zǐ xiàng wǒ tí chū le hěn duō wèn tí ， què sì hū cóng bù tīng wǒ de huí dá 。
sentences.english: It took me a long time to understand where he came from. The little prince asked many questions, yet never seemed to hear mine.

sentences.chinese: 当他第一次看到我的飞机时，他好奇地问：“这是什么东西？”我说：“这是会飞的飞机。”
sentences.pinyin: dāng tā dì yī cì kàn dào wǒ de fēi jī shí ， tā hào qí dì wèn ： “ zhè shì shén me dōng xī ？ ” wǒ shuō ： “ zhè shì huì fēi de fēi jī 。 ”
sentences.english: When he first caught sight of my airplane, he asked curiously: "What is that thing?" I said: "It is an airplane that flies."

sentences.chinese: 他惊讶地喊道：“什么！你是从天上掉下来的吗？”随后发出了一阵清脆动听的笑声。
sentences.pinyin: tā jīng yà dì hǎn dào ： “ shén me ！ nǐ shì cóng tiān shàng diào xià lái de ma ？ ” suí hòu fā chū le yī zhèn qīng cuì dòng tīng de xiào shēng 。
sentences.english: He cried in wonder: "What! Did you drop from the sky?" And then he let out a lovely, ringing laugh.

sentences.chinese: 他打量着我的画箱：“真好，夜晚可以把这个箱子当成它的房子。”
sentences.pinyin: tā dǎ liang zhuó wǒ de huà xiāng ： “ zhēn hǎo ， yè wǎn kě yǐ bǎ zhè gè xiāng zǐ dāng chéng tā de fáng zǐ 。 ”
sentences.english: He examined my drawing box: "How wonderful, at night he can use this box as his little house."

sentences.chinese: 我说：“如果它乖，我还会给你一根绳子和一根木桩，白天可以把它拴住。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shuō ： “ rú guǒ tā guāi ， wǒ hái huì gěi nǐ yī gēn shéng zǐ hé yī gēn mù zhuāng ， bái tiān kě yǐ bǎ tā shuān zhù 。 ”
sentences.english: I said: "And if he is good, I will give you a rope and a post to tie him up during the day."

sentences.chinese: 小王子听了十分诧异：“把它拴住？多么奇怪的想法！它能跑到哪里去呢？在我那里，所有的东西都那么小，一直往前走，也走不了多远……”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ tīng le shí fēn chà yì ： “ bǎ tā shuān zhù ？ duō me qí guài de xiǎng fǎ ！ tā néng pǎo dào nǎ lǐ qù ne ？ zài wǒ nà lǐ ， suǒ yǒu de dōng xī dōu nà me xiǎo ， yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu ， yě zǒu bù le duō yuǎn … … ”
sentences.english: The little prince was surprised: "Tie him up? What a strange idea! Where could he go? Where I live, everything is so tiny—even if one goes straight ahead, one cannot go very far..."

title: 第四章：小行星B612与大人对数字的执念
titleEn: Chapter 4: Asteroid B-612 & Adults Obsessed with Numbers

sentences.chinese: 我有充分的理由相信，小王子离开的那颗星球就是小行星B612。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu chōng fēn de lǐ yóu xiāng xìn ， xiǎo wáng zǐ lí kāi de nà kē xīng qiú jiù shì xiǎo xíng xīng B 6 1 2 。
sentences.english: I have serious reason to believe that the planet the little prince came from is Asteroid B-612.

sentences.chinese: 这颗小行星在1909年曾被一位土耳其天文学家通过望远镜观察到，但他当时因穿着民族服装而不被学术界信任。
sentences.pinyin: zhè kē xiǎo xíng xīng zài 1 9 0 9 nián céng bèi yī wèi tǔ ěr qí tiān wén xué jiā tōng guò wàng yuǎn jìng guān chá dào ， dàn tā dāng shí yīn chuān zhuó mín zú fú zhuāng ér bù bèi xué shù jiè xìn rèn 。
sentences.english: This asteroid was seen only once through a telescope in 1909 by a Turkish astronomer, who was dismissed because of his traditional attire.

sentences.chinese: 大人们就是这样，他们深爱着枯燥的数字。
sentences.pinyin: dà rén mén jiù shì zhè yàng ， tā mén shēn ài zhuó kū zào de shù zì 。
sentences.english: Grown-ups are like that; they have a profound passion for dry numbers.

sentences.chinese: 如果你对大人们说：“我看到了一座用玫瑰色砖块砌成、窗台上开满天竺葵、屋顶上停着白鸽的漂亮房子。”他们根本想象不出这所房子有多美。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ duì dà rén mén shuō ： “ wǒ kàn dào le yī zuò yòng méi guī sè zhuān kuài qì chéng 、 chuāng tái shàng kāi mǎn tiān zhú kuí 、 wū dǐng shàng tíng zhuó bái gē de piāo liàng fáng zǐ 。 ” tā mén gēn běn xiǎng xiàng bù chū zhè suǒ fáng zǐ yǒu duō měi 。
sentences.english: If you tell grown-ups: "I saw a beautiful house made of rosy brick, with geraniums in the windows and doves on the roof," they cannot imagine it at all.

sentences.chinese: 但如果你对他们说：“我看到了一座价值十万法郎的房子。”他们就会惊叹：“那真是太华丽了！”
sentences.pinyin: dàn rú guǒ nǐ duì tā mén shuō ： “ wǒ kàn dào le yī zuò jià zhí shí wàn fǎ láng de fáng zǐ 。 ” tā mén jiù huì jīng tàn ： “ nà zhēn shì tài huá lì le ！ ”
sentences.english: But if you say to them: "I saw a house worth a hundred thousand francs," they will exclaim: "Oh, how magnificent!"

sentences.chinese: 为了不让小王子被遗忘，我买了颜料和画笔，努力在纸上重现他的模样。遗忘一个朋友是一件极其悲哀的事情。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bù ràng xiǎo wáng zǐ bèi yí wàng ， wǒ mǎi le yán liào hé huà bǐ ， nǔ lì zài zhǐ shàng zhòng xiàn tā de mú yàng 。 yí wàng yī gè péng yǒu shì yī jiàn jí qí bēi āi de shì qíng 。
sentences.english: To ensure the little prince is not forgotten, I bought paints and pencils, striving to capture his form on paper. Forgetting a friend is a deeply sorrowful thing.

title: 第五章：猴面包树的幼苗与每日清理的责任
titleEn: Chapter 5: The Threat of Baobab Trees & Daily Vigilance

sentences.chinese: 每天我都能从小王子的交谈中了解到关于他的星球、他的离开和他的旅程的新秘密。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān wǒ dōu néng cóng xiǎo wáng zǐ de jiāo tán zhōng liǎo jiě dào guān yú tā de xīng qiú 、 tā de lí kāi hé tā de lǚ chéng de xīn mì mì 。
sentences.english: Every day I learned something new about the prince’s planet, his departure, and his cosmic journey.

sentences.chinese: 到了第三天，我知道了关于猴面包树的可怕悲剧。
sentences.pinyin: dào le dì sān tiān ， wǒ zhī dào le guān yú hóu miàn bāo shù de kě pà bēi jù 。
sentences.english: On the third day, I learned of the terrible tragedy regarding the baobab trees.

sentences.chinese: 小王子问我：“绵羊真的会吃小灌木吗？”我回答：“是的。”小王子高兴地说：“太好了！那它们也会吃猴面包树吧？”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn wǒ ： “ mián yáng zhēn de huì chī xiǎo guàn mù ma ？ ” wǒ huí dá ： “ shì de 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ gāo xìng dì shuō ： “ tài hǎo le ！ nà tā mén yě huì chī hóu miàn bāo shù bā ？ ”
sentences.english: The little prince asked me: "Do sheep eat little bushes?" I answered: "Yes." The prince rejoiced: "Splendid! Then they also eat baobabs?"

sentences.chinese: 我向他解释，猴面包树可不是小灌木，而是像教堂一样庞大的参天巨树，即使带上一群大象也啃不完一棵猴面包树。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiàng tā jiě shì ， hóu miàn bāo shù kě bù shì xiǎo guàn mù ， ér shì xiàng jiào táng yī yàng páng dà de cān tiān jù shù ， jí shǐ dài shàng yī qún dà xiàng yě kěn bù wán yī kē hóu miàn bāo shù 。
sentences.english: I explained that baobabs are not little bushes, but trees as immense as cathedrals, and a whole herd of elephants could not eat a single one.

sentences.chinese: 小王子聪明地指出：“猴面包树在长大之前，也是从小苗开始长起的呀。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ cōng míng dì zhǐ chū ： “ hóu miàn bāo shù zài cháng dà zhī qián ， yě shì cóng xiǎo miáo kāi shǐ cháng qǐ de yā 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince wisely pointed out: "Before baobabs grow huge, they start out as tiny little sprouts."

sentences.chinese: 在他的星球上，好植物长出好种子，坏植物长出坏种子。如果不及时拔掉猴面包树的幼苗，它们庞大的根系就会把整颗微小的星球撑得四分五裂。
sentences.pinyin: zài tā de xīng qiú shàng ， hǎo zhí wù cháng chū hǎo zhǒng zi ， huài zhí wù cháng chū huài zhǒng zi 。 rú guǒ bù jí shí bá diào hóu miàn bāo shù de yòu miáo ， tā mén páng dà de gēn xì jiù huì bǎ zhěng kē wēi xiǎo de xīng qiú chēng dé sì fēn wǔ liè 。
sentences.english: On his planet, good plants grow good seeds, bad plants grow bad seeds. If baobabs are not weeded immediately, their roots will pierce and split the tiny world apart.

sentences.chinese: 小王子说：“这是一件纪律严明的事。每天早晨梳洗完毕后，就必须认真地去清理星球。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō ： “ zhè shì yī jiàn jì lǜ yán míng de shì 。 měi tiān zǎo chén shū xǐ wán bì hòu ， jiù bì xū rèn zhēn dì qù qīng lǐ xīng qiú 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince said: "It is a matter of discipline. When you finish washing in the morning, you must carefully clean up the planet."

title: 第六章：四十四次日落与忧郁的落日之美
titleEn: Chapter 6: Forty-Four Sunsets & The Solace of Twilight

sentences.chinese: 啊，小王子！我就是这样一点一点地理解了你那忧郁而恬静的微小生命。
sentences.pinyin: ā ， xiǎo wáng zǐ ！ wǒ jiù shì zhè yàng yī diǎn yī diǎn dì lǐ jiě le nǐ nà yōu yù ér tián jìng de wēi xiǎo shēng mìng 。
sentences.english: Ah, little prince! Bit by bit I came to understand the secrets of your sad, gentle little life.

sentences.chinese: 在很长一段时间里，你唯一的乐趣就是静静地观赏落日带来的温柔余晖。
sentences.pinyin: zài hěn cháng yī duàn shí jiān lǐ ， nǐ wéi yī de lè qù jiù shì jìng jìng dì guān shǎng luò rì dài lái de wēn róu yú huī 。
sentences.english: For a long time your only entertainment had been the quiet pleasure of watching sunsets.

sentences.chinese: 第四天早晨，你对我说：“我非常喜欢日落。我们去看一次日落吧……”
sentences.pinyin: dì sì tiān zǎo chén ， nǐ duì wǒ shuō ： “ wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huān rì luò 。 wǒ mén qù kàn yī cì rì luò bā … … ”
sentences.english: On the fourth morning, you said to me: "I love sunsets very much. Let us go watch a sunset now..."

sentences.chinese: 我对你说：“但我们必须等待。”你问：“等什么？”我说：“等太阳落山啊。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì nǐ shuō ： “ dàn wǒ mén bì xū děng dài 。 ” nǐ wèn ： “ děng shén me ？ ” wǒ shuō ： “ děng tài yáng luò shān ā 。 ”
sentences.english: I told you: "But we must wait." You asked: "Wait for what?" I said: "Wait for the sun to go down."

sentences.english: At first you seemed surprised, then you laughed at yourself: "I always think I am still at home on my own planet!"

sentences.english: "One day," you said, "I watched the sunset forty-four times!" A moment later you added: "You know... when one is terribly sad, one loves the sunset."

title: 第七章：花朵的刺与小王子眼中的宇宙之泪
titleEn: Chapter 7: The Thorns & The Secrets of Sacred Tears

sentences.chinese: 第五天，借助小绵羊的话题，小王子的生活秘密彻底向我敞开了。
sentences.pinyin: dì wǔ tiān ， jiè zhù xiǎo mián yáng de huà tí ， xiǎo wáng zǐ de shēng huó mì mì chè dǐ xiàng wǒ chǎng kāi le 。
sentences.english: On the fifth day, through the subject of the sheep, the secret of the little prince’s life was revealed to me.

sentences.chinese: 他突然问我：“如果羊吃小灌木，它也会吃花吗？”我回答：“羊看见什么就吃什么。”
sentences.pinyin: tā tū rán wèn wǒ ： “ rú guǒ yáng chī xiǎo guàn mù ， tā yě huì chī huā ma ？ ” wǒ huí dá ： “ yáng kàn jiàn shén me jiù chī shén me 。 ”

sentences.english: "Even flowers with thorns?" "Yes, even flowers that have thorns."

sentences.pinyin: “ nà huā ér shēn shàng de cì jiū jìng yǒu shén me yòng ne ？ ” dāng shí wǒ zhèng máng zhuó xiū lǐ kǎ sǐ de luó shuān ， biàn fán zào dì suí kǒu dá dào ： “ cì shén me yòng yě méi yǒu ， chún cuì shì huā duǒ de è yì ！ ”
sentences.english: "Then what purpose do thorns serve?" Busy fixing a jammed bolt, I answered irritably: "Thorns serve no purpose at all; they are pure spite from flowers!"

sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ chén mò piàn kè hòu ， qì dé hún shēn fā dǒu ， yǎn lǐ shǎn shuò zhuó lèi guāng ： “ wǒ bù xìn ！ huā duǒ shì róu ruò de 、 tiān zhēn de 。 tā mén yǐ wèi yǒu le cì jiù néng bǎo hù zì jǐ ！ ”
sentences.english: The little prince grew pale with indignation: "I don't believe you! Flowers are weak and naive. They think their thorns make them terrible and safe!"

sentences.chinese: 他激动地喊道：“如果一个人爱上一朵世上独一无二的花，那朵花只长在亿万颗星星中的一颗上，只要抬头看着星空，他就会感到无比幸福。可如果羊把花吃掉了，对他而言，就像所有的星星瞬间熄灭了一样！这难道不重要吗？”

sentences.english: He cried passionately: "If someone loves a flower, the only one of its kind in millions of stars, looking at the sky makes him happy. But if the sheep eats the flower, to him it is as if all the stars went dark at once! Does that not matter?"

sentences.chinese: 他再也说不下去了，突然失声痛哭起来。夜色降临，我扔下了手中的扳手，将他紧紧抱在怀里，轻轻摇晃着他：“泪水的国度，是多么神秘莫测啊。”
sentences.pinyin: tā zài yě shuō bù xià qù le ， tū rán shī shēng tòng kū qǐ lái 。 yè sè jiàng lín ， wǒ rēng xià le shǒu zhōng de bān shǒu ， jiāng tā jǐn jǐn bào zài huái lǐ ， qīng qīng yáo huǎng zhuó tā ： “ lèi shuǐ de guó dù ， shì duō me shén mì mò cè ā 。 ”
sentences.english: He could say no more, bursting into tears. Night fell; I dropped my tools and took him into my arms: "The land of tears is so mysterious and uncharted."

title: 第八章：娇艳玫瑰的诞生与她的骄傲与谎言
titleEn: Chapter 8: The Birth of the Rose & Her Fragile Pride

sentences.chinese: 我很快就更深入地了解了那朵花。在小王子的星球上，以往只有简单的单层花朵，从不引人注意。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn kuài jiù gèng shēn rù dì liǎo jiě le nà duǒ huā 。 zài xiǎo wáng zǐ de xīng qiú shàng ， yǐ wǎng zhǐ yǒu jiǎn dān de dān céng huā duǒ ， cóng bù yǐn rén zhù yì 。
sentences.english: I soon learned to know this flower better. On the prince’s planet, there had always been simple flowers with single rings of petals.

sentences.chinese: 但有一天，一粒不知从何处飘来的神秘种子发芽了。小王子细心地看护着这棵奇特的幼苗。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yǒu yī tiān ， yī lì bù zhī cóng hé chù piāo lái de shén mì zhǒng zi fā yá le 。 xiǎo wáng zǐ xì xīn dì kān hù zhuó zhè kē qí tè de yòu miáo 。
sentences.english: But one day, a seed blown from an unknown place sprouted. The little prince watched over this curious green shoot closely.

sentences.chinese: 这朵花在绿色的花萼里精心挑选自己的衣裳，精心搭配花瓣的颜色。她不愿像野罂粟那样带着褶皱出场，只愿在最绚烂的光彩中绽放。
sentences.pinyin: zhè duǒ huā zài lǜ sè de huā è lǐ jīng xīn tiāo xuǎn zì jǐ de yī cháng ， jīng xīn dā pèi huā bàn de yán sè 。 tā bù yuàn xiàng yě yīng sù nà yàng dài zhuó zhě zhòu chū chǎng ， zhǐ yuàn zài zuì xuàn làn de guāng cǎi zhōng zhàn fàng 。
sentences.english: The flower dressed herself meticulously inside her green chamber, choosing colors with care, wishing to emerge only in the full radiance of beauty.

sentences.chinese: 终于，在一个晴朗的早晨，伴随着朝阳升起，她绽放了花瓣，打着哈欠娇柔地说道：“啊！我才刚刚睡醒……请原谅，我的花瓣还没梳理整齐呢……”
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú ， zài yī gè qíng lǎng de zǎo chén ， bàn suí zhuó cháo yáng shēng qǐ ， tā zhàn fàng le huā bàn ， dǎ zhuó hā qiàn jiāo róu dì shuō dào ： “ ā ！ wǒ cái gāng gāng shuì xǐng … … qǐng yuán liàng ， wǒ de huā bàn hái méi shū lǐ zhěng qí ne … … ”
sentences.english: At sunrise she unfolded her petals, yawning sweetly: "Ah! I have just awakened... forgive me, my petals are still untidy..."

sentences.chinese: 小王子禁不住由衷地赞叹：“你真美啊！”花儿轻声答道：“是吧？我是和太阳同时出生的呢……”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ jīn bù zhù yóu zhōng dì zàn tàn ： “ nǐ zhēn měi ā ！ ” huā ér qīng shēng dá dào ： “ shì bā ？ wǒ shì hé tài yáng tóng shí chū shēng de ne … … ”
sentences.english: The little prince could not contain his admiration: "How beautiful you are!" The flower replied softly: "Am I not? And I was born at the same moment as the sun..."

sentences.chinese: 但这朵花儿不仅美丽，还带着虚荣与多疑。她炫耀自己的四根刺，声称自己不怕老虎，却害怕冷风，要求小王子在夜晚为她套上玻璃罩。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhè duǒ huā ér bù jǐn měi lì ， hái dài zhuó xū róng yǔ duō yí 。 tā xuàn yào zì jǐ de sì gēn cì ， shēng chēng zì jǐ bù pà lǎo hǔ ， què hài pà lěng fēng ， yào qiú xiǎo wáng zǐ zài yè wǎn wèi tā tào shàng bō lí zhào 。
sentences.english: Yet this flower was also vain and demanding. She showed off her four thorns, claimed she feared no tigers, yet feared drafts and demanded a glass globe at night.

sentences.chinese: 小王子回忆道：“我那时太年轻了，不懂得如何去爱她。我应该根据她的行动而不是言语来评判她。她的芬芳充盈了我的星球，我本不该离开她逃走。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ huí yì dào ： “ wǒ nà shí tài nián qīng le ， bù dǒng dé rú hé qù ài tā 。 wǒ yīng gāi gēn jù tā de xíng dòng ér bù shì yán yǔ lái píng pàn tā 。 tā de fēn fāng chōng yíng le wǒ de xīng qiú ， wǒ běn bù gāi lí kāi tā táo zǒu 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince reflected: "I was too young to know how to love her. I should have judged her by deeds rather than words. She perfumed my planet, and I should never have run away."

title: 第九章：清理火山、告别玫瑰与借助候鸟离开
titleEn: Chapter 9: Leaving the Rose & Migration with Wild Birds

sentences.chinese: 我相信小王子是借助一群迁徙的候鸟离开他的星球的。

sentences.english: I believe that for his departure, the little prince took advantage of a migration of wild birds.

sentences.chinese: 出发的那个清晨，他把自己的星球打扫得干干净净。他认真地疏通了两座活火山，顺便也清理了一座死火山。
sentences.pinyin: chū fā de nà gè qīng chén ， tā bǎ zì jǐ de xīng qiú dǎ sǎo dé gān gān jìng jìng 。 tā rèn zhēn dì shū tōng le liǎng zuò huó huǒ shān ， shùn biàn yě qīng lǐ le yī zuò sǐ huǒ shān 。

sentences.english: With a heavy heart, he also pulled up the last baobab shoots. He believed he would never return.

sentences.pinyin: dāng tā zuì hòu yī cì gěi méi guī jiāo shuǐ ， zhǔn bèi wèi tā gài shàng bō lí zhào shí ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ hěn xiǎng kū qì 。
sentences.english: When he watered his rose one last time and prepared to place her under the glass globe, he felt close to tears.

sentences.chinese: “再见。”他对花儿说。花儿没有回答。“再见。”他又说了一遍。
sentences.pinyin: “ zài jiàn 。 ” tā duì huā ér shuō 。 huā ér méi yǒu huí dá 。 “ zài jiàn 。 ” tā yòu shuō le yī biàn 。
sentences.english: "Goodbye," he said to the flower. She did not answer. "Goodbye," he repeated gently.

sentences.chinese: 花儿咳嗽了一声，轻声说：“我以前真蠢。请你原谅我。祝你幸福。”小王子为她的平静与毫无怨言感到惊讶。
sentences.pinyin: huā ér ké sòu le yī shēng ， qīng shēng shuō ： “ wǒ yǐ qián zhēn chǔn 。 qǐng nǐ yuán liàng wǒ 。 zhù nǐ xìng fú 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèi tā de píng jìng yǔ háo wú yuàn yán gǎn dào jīng yà 。
sentences.english: The flower coughed and said softly: "I have been silly. I ask your forgiveness. Try to be happy." The prince was astonished by her calm lack of reproaches.

sentences.chinese: “是的，我是爱你的，”花儿对他说，“没能让你明白这一点，是我的错。但你也一样傻。把玻璃罩拿走吧，我不再需要它了。夜晚的新鲜空气对我的健康有好处。我是一朵花啊。”
sentences.pinyin: “ shì de ， wǒ shì ài nǐ de ， ” huā ér duì tā shuō ， “ méi néng ràng nǐ míng bái zhè yī diǎn ， shì wǒ de cuò 。 dàn nǐ yě yī yàng shǎ 。 bǎ bō lí zhào ná zǒu bā ， wǒ bù zài xū yào tā le 。 yè wǎn de xīn xiān kōng qì duì wǒ de jiàn kāng yǒu hǎo chù 。 wǒ shì yī duǒ huā ā 。 ”

sentences.pinyin: “ kuài zǒu bā ， bié mó mó cèng cèng de ， jì rán nǐ jué dìng yào lí kāi ， nà jiù zǒu bā ！ ” yīn wèi tā tài jiāo ào le ， bù xiǎng ràng xiǎo wáng zǐ kàn dào tā liú xià de lèi shuǐ 。
sentences.english: "Go now, do not linger like this; you decided to leave, so go!" For she was too proud to let him see her weep.

title: 第十章：第325号小行星：独自统治的国王
titleEn: Chapter 10: Asteroid 325: The King Who Rules Solitude

sentences.chinese: 小王子的宇宙旅程首先来到了第325、326、327、328、329和330号小行星。

sentences.english: The little prince found himself in the neighborhood of asteroids 325, 326, 327, 328, 329, and 330.

sentences.pinyin: zài dì yī kē xīng qiú shàng ， zhù zhuó yī wèi shēn chuān zǐ páo hé bái diāo pí dà yī de guó wáng ， wēi yán dì zuò zài jí qí jiǎn pǔ què zhuāng yán de bǎo zuò shàng 。
sentences.english: On the first planet lived a king, dressed in purple and ermine, seated upon a throne that was both simple and majestic.

sentences.chinese: 国王一见到小王子就喊道：“啊！来了一个臣民！”小王子纳闷：他以前从没见过我，怎么会认得我呢？

sentences.english: The king exclaimed upon seeing him: "Ah! Here is a subject!" The prince wondered: How can he recognize me when he has never seen me before?

sentences.chinese: 小王子累得打了个哈欠。国王威严地命令：“在国王面前打哈欠是违反礼仪的，我禁止你打哈欠！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ léi dé dǎ le gè hā qiàn 。 guó wáng wēi yán dì mìng lìng ： “ zài guó wáng miàn qián dǎ hā qiàn shì wéi fǎn lǐ yí de ， wǒ jīn zhǐ nǐ dǎ hā qiàn ！ ”
sentences.english: Fatigued, the prince yawned. The king declared: "It is contrary to etiquette to yawn before a king; I forbid you to yawn!"

sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ nán wèi qíng dì shuō ： “ wǒ rěn bù zhù ， wǒ zǒu le hěn yuǎn de lù ， hái méi shuì jué ne … … ” guó wáng lì kè gǎi kǒu ： “ nà wǒ mìng lìng nǐ dǎ hā qiàn ！ wǒ yǐ jīng hěn duō nián méi jiàn guò bié rén dǎ hā qiàn le 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince blushed: "I could not help it, I made a long journey and had no sleep..." The king quickly amended: "Then I command you to yawn! I have not seen anyone yawn in years."

sentences.chinese: 小王子向国王请求：“陛下，请命令太阳落山吧，我想看一次日落。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ xiàng guó wáng qǐng qiú ： “ bì xià ， qǐng mìng lìng tài yáng luò shān bā ， wǒ xiǎng kàn yī cì rì luò 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince requested: "Sire, please command the sun to set; I wish to see a sunset."

sentences.chinese: 国王理智地回答：“向每个人提出的要求，应该是他们力所能及的。权威首先建立在理性的基础之上。我命令太阳在今晚七点四十分落山，你会看到我的命令被精准执行！”
sentences.pinyin: guó wáng lǐ zhì dì huí dá ： “ xiàng měi gè rén tí chū de yào qiú ， yīng gāi shì tā mén lì suǒ néng jí de 。 quán wēi shǒu xiān jiàn lì zài lǐ xìng de jī chǔ zhī shàng 。 wǒ mìng lìng tài yáng zài jīn wǎn qī diǎn sì shí fēn luò shān ， nǐ huì kàn dào wǒ de mìng lìng bèi jīng zhǔn zhí xíng ！ ”
sentences.english: The king replied wisely: "One must require from each what each can give. Authority rests first upon reason. I shall command the sun to set tonight at twenty to eight, and you will see how well I am obeyed!"

sentences.chinese: 小王子感到无趣，准备告辞。国王为了留住他，甚至许诺任命他为司法大臣。小王子叹息道：“大人们真是太奇怪了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ gǎn dào wú qù ， zhǔn bèi gào cí 。 guó wáng wèi le liú zhù tā ， shèn zhì xǔ nuò rèn mìng tā wèi sī fǎ dà chén 。 xiǎo wáng zǐ tàn xī dào ： “ dà rén mén zhēn shì tài qí guài le 。 ”
sentences.english: Bored, the prince prepared to leave. To retain him, the king offered to make him Minister of Justice. The prince sighed: "Grown-ups are truly astonishing."

title: 第十一章：第326号小行星：渴望掌声的虚荣者
titleEn: Chapter 11: Asteroid 326: The Conceited Man Craving Praise

sentences.chinese: 第二颗行星上住着一个爱虚荣的人。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr kē xíng xīng shàng zhù zhuó yī gè ài xū róng de rén 。
sentences.english: The second planet was inhabited by a conceited man.

sentences.chinese: “啊！一个崇拜者来拜访我了！”虚荣者老远看到小王子就高呼起来。在虚荣者眼里，所有别的人都是他的崇拜者。
sentences.pinyin: “ ā ！ yī gè chóng bài zhě lái bài fǎng wǒ le ！ ” xū róng zhě lǎo yuǎn kàn dào xiǎo wáng zǐ jiù gāo hū qǐ lái 。 zài xū róng zhě yǎn lǐ ， suǒ yǒu bié de rén dōu shì tā de chóng bài zhě 。
sentences.english: "Ah! An admirer comes to visit me!" the conceited man cried from afar. For to conceited men, all others are admirers.

sentences.chinese: 虚荣者头上戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。他说：“这是用来致意行礼的，当有人为我鼓掌时，我就举起帽子致意。请你拍手吧！”
sentences.pinyin: xū róng zhě tóu shàng dài zhuó yī dǐng huá jī de mào zǐ 。 tā shuō ： “ zhè shì yòng lái zhì yì xíng lǐ de ， dāng yǒu rén wèi wǒ gǔ zhǎng shí ， wǒ jiù jǔ qǐ mào zǐ zhì yì 。 qǐng nǐ pāi shǒu bā ！ ”
sentences.english: He wore a curious hat: "It is for saluting when people applaud me. Clap your hands together!"

sentences.chinese: 小王子拍了拍手，虚荣者便得意洋洋地举起帽子行礼。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ pāi le pāi shǒu ， xū róng zhě biàn dé yì yáng yáng dì jǔ qǐ mào zǐ xíng lǐ 。
sentences.english: The little prince clapped his hands, and the conceited man modestly lifted his hat in salute.

sentences.chinese: 连续鼓掌五分钟后，小王子觉得单调乏味：“要怎么做才能让帽子掉下来呢？”虚荣者却充耳不闻，因为虚荣的人只能听见赞美的话。
sentences.pinyin: lián xù gǔ zhǎng wǔ fēn zhōng hòu ， xiǎo wáng zǐ jué dé dān tiáo fá wèi ： “ yào zěn me zuò cái néng ràng mào zǐ diào xià lái ne ？ ” xū róng zhě què chōng ěr bù wén ， yīn wèi xū róng de rén zhǐ néng tīng jiàn zàn měi de huà 。
sentences.english: After five minutes of clapping, the prince tired of the game: "What must one do to make the hat fall off?" But the conceited man heard nothing, for conceited men hear only praise.

sentences.chinese: “你真的非常崇拜我吗？”他问小王子。“‘崇拜’是什么意思？”小王子问。“就是承认我是这颗星球上最英俊、最会穿衣服、最富有和最聪明的人！”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ zhēn de fēi cháng chóng bài wǒ ma ？ ” tā wèn xiǎo wáng zǐ 。 “ ‘ chóng bài ’ shì shén me yì sī ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ jiù shì chéng rèn wǒ shì zhè kē xīng qiú shàng zuì yīng jùn 、 zuì huì chuān yī fú 、 zuì fù yǒu hé zuì cōng míng de rén ！ ”
sentences.english: "Do you truly admire me greatly?" he asked. "What does admire mean?" asked the prince. "It means recognizing that I am the most handsome, best dressed, richest, and most intelligent man on the planet!"

sentences.chinese: “可这颗星球上只有你一个人啊！”“那就请行行好，无论如何崇拜我吧！”小王子耸耸肩离开了：“大人们确实古怪极了。”
sentences.pinyin: “ kě zhè kē xīng qiú shàng zhǐ yǒu nǐ yī gè rén ā ！ ” “ nà jiù qǐng xíng xíng hǎo ， wú lùn rú hé chóng bài wǒ bā ！ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ sǒng sǒng jiān lí kāi le ： “ dà rén mén què shí gǔ guài jí le 。 ”
sentences.english: "But you are alone on your planet!" "Do me this favor; admire me anyway!" The prince shrugged and left: "Grown-ups are definitely very odd."

title: 第十二章：第327号小行星：为了忘却羞愧而喝酒的酒鬼
titleEn: Chapter 12: Asteroid 327: The Tippler Drinking to Forget

sentences.chinese: 下一颗星球上住着一个酒鬼。这次拜访时间非常短暂，却让小王子陷入了极深的悲伤之中。
sentences.pinyin: xià yī kē xīng qiú shàng zhù zhuó yī gè jiǔ guǐ 。 zhè cì bài fǎng shí jiān fēi cháng duǎn zàn ， què ràng xiǎo wáng zǐ xiàn rù le jí shēn de bēi shāng zhī zhōng 。
sentences.english: The next planet was inhabited by a tippler. This brief visit plunged the little prince into profound sadness.

sentences.chinese: 酒鬼默默地坐在由一堆空瓶子和一堆满瓶子组成的桌子前。
sentences.pinyin: jiǔ guǐ mò mò dì zuò zài yóu yī duī kōng píng zǐ hé yī duī mǎn píng zǐ zǔ chéng de zhuō zǐ qián 。
sentences.english: The tippler sat in silence before a collection of empty bottles and full bottles.

sentences.chinese: “你在这里做什么？”小王子问。“我喝酒。”酒鬼神情沮丧地回答。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ wǒ hē jiǔ 。 ” jiǔ guǐ shén qíng jǔ sàng dì huí dá 。
sentences.english: "What are you doing here?" asked the little prince. "I am drinking," replied the tippler lugubriously.

sentences.chinese: “你为什么喝酒呢？”小王子继续关切地问。“为了忘却。”酒鬼低垂着头。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ wèi shén me hē jiǔ ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ jì xù guān qiē dì wèn 。 “ wèi le wàng què 。 ” jiǔ guǐ dī chuí zhuó tóu 。
sentences.english: "Why do you drink?" the prince asked with concern. "To forget," the tippler hung his head.

sentences.chinese: “忘却什么呢？”小王子想帮助他。“忘却我的羞愧。”酒鬼坦白道。
sentences.pinyin: “ wàng què shén me ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ xiǎng bāng zhù tā 。 “ wàng què wǒ de xiū kuì 。 ” jiǔ guǐ tǎn bái dào 。
sentences.english: "To forget what?" the prince inquired, wishing to help. "To forget that I am ashamed," the tippler confessed.

sentences.chinese: “你羞愧什么呢？”小王子同情地问。“羞愧我喝酒！”酒鬼说完便彻底陷入了沉默。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ xiū kuì shén me ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ tóng qíng dì wèn 。 “ xiū kuì wǒ hē jiǔ ！ ” jiǔ guǐ shuō wán biàn chè dǐ xiàn rù le chén mò 。
sentences.english: "Ashamed of what?" asked the prince with sympathy. "Ashamed of drinking!" The tippler concluded, retreating into absolute silence.

sentences.chinese: 小王子困惑而茫然地离开了：“大人们毫无疑问真是太奇怪了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ kùn huò ér máng rán dì lí kāi le ： “ dà rén mén háo wú yí wèn zhēn shì tài qí guài le 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince went away, perplexed and sorrowful: "Grown-ups are without a doubt very, very strange."

title: 第十三章：第328号小行星：日夜数星星的实业家
titleEn: Chapter 13: Asteroid 328: The Businessman Counting Stars

sentences.chinese: 第四颗星球属于一个实业家。这个人忙得不可开交，小王子到来时他甚至连头都没有抬一下。
sentences.pinyin: dì sì kē xīng qiú shǔ yú yī gè shí yè jiā 。 zhè gè rén máng dé bù kě kāi jiāo ， xiǎo wáng zǐ dào lái shí tā shèn zhì lián tóu dōu méi yǒu tái yī xià 。
sentences.english: The fourth planet belonged to a businessman. This man was so engrossed in his calculations that he did not even raise his head.

sentences.chinese: “三加二等于五。五加七等于十二……五亿一百六十二万二千七百三十一。”商人嘴里不断念叨着。
sentences.pinyin: “ sān jiā èr děng yú wǔ 。 wǔ jiā qī děng yú shí èr … … wǔ yì yī bǎi liù shí èr wàn èr qiān qī bǎi sān shí yī 。 ” shāng rén zuǐ lǐ bù duàn niàn dāo zhuó 。
sentences.english: "Three and two make five. Five and seven make twelve... five hundred and one million, six hundred twenty-two thousand, seven hundred thirty-one," the businessman muttered.

sentences.chinese: “五亿什么东西？”小王子问。“五亿颗闪闪发光的小东西。我占有它们，我拥有五亿颗星星，这样我就很富有！”商人傲慢地说。
sentences.pinyin: “ wǔ yì shén me dōng xī ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ wǔ yì kē shǎn shǎn fā guāng de xiǎo dōng xī 。 wǒ zhàn yǒu tā mén ， wǒ yōng yǒu wǔ yì kē xīng xīng ， zhè yàng wǒ jiù hěn fù yǒu ！ ” shāng rén ào màn dì shuō 。
sentences.english: "Five hundred million what?" asked the prince. "Five hundred million little glittering things in the sky. I own them, which makes me rich!" the businessman declared.

sentences.chinese: 小王子不解：“拥有星星对你有什么用呢？”商人答：“能让我买下更多别的星星。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ bù jiě ： “ yōng yǒu xīng xīng duì nǐ yǒu shén me yòng ne ？ ” shāng rén dá ： “ néng ràng wǒ mǎi xià gèng duō bié de xīng xīng 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince asked: "And what good does it do you to own stars?" "It allows me to buy more stars if any are discovered."

sentences.chinese: 小王子反驳道：“我拥有一朵花，我每天给她浇水；我拥有三座火山，我每周给它们清灰。我对我的花和火山是有益处的。但你对星星却没有任何益处！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ fǎn bó dào ： “ wǒ yōng yǒu yī duǒ huā ， wǒ měi tiān gěi tā jiāo shuǐ ； wǒ yōng yǒu sān zuò huǒ shān ， wǒ měi zhōu gěi tā mén qīng huī 。 wǒ duì wǒ de huā hé huǒ shān shì yǒu yì chù de 。 dàn nǐ duì xīng xīng què méi yǒu rèn hé yì chù ！ ”
sentences.english: The prince argued: "I own a flower, which I water every day; I own three volcanoes, which I sweep every week. It is useful to my flower and volcanoes that I own them. But you are of no use to the stars!"

sentences.chinese: 商人张口结舌，无言以对。小王子再次踏上了旅途：“大人们的逻辑真是匪夷所思。”
sentences.pinyin: shāng rén zhāng kǒu jié shé ， wú yán yǐ duì 。 xiǎo wáng zǐ zài cì tà shàng le lǚ tú ： “ dà rén mén de luó jí zhēn shì fěi yí suǒ sī 。 ”
sentences.english: The businessman opened his mouth but could find nothing to say. The prince resumed his journey: "Grown-ups are utterly extraordinary."

title: 第十四章：第329号小行星：忠于职责的点灯人
titleEn: Chapter 14: Asteroid 329: The Faithful Lamplighter

sentences.chinese: 第五颗行星非常奇特，它是所有行星中最小的一颗，刚好只能容纳一盏路灯和一个点灯人。
sentences.pinyin: dì wǔ kē xíng xīng fēi cháng qí tè ， tā shì suǒ yǒu xíng xīng zhōng zuì xiǎo de yī kē ， gāng hǎo zhǐ néng róng nà yī zhǎn lù dēng hé yī gè diǎn dēng rén 。
sentences.english: The fifth planet was the smallest of all, having just enough room for a street lamp and a lamplighter.

sentences.chinese: 小王子想：这个人虽然看起来荒谬，但他点亮路灯，就像在夜空中点燃了一颗新星或唤醒了一朵花；当他熄灭路灯，就像让花儿或星星入睡，这是一项美丽的职业。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ xiǎng ： zhè gè rén suī rán kàn qǐ lái huāng miù ， dàn tā diǎn liàng lù dēng ， jiù xiàng zài yè kōng zhōng diǎn rán le yī kē xīn xīng huò huàn xǐng le yī duǒ huā ； dāng tā xī miè lù dēng ， jiù xiàng ràng huā ér huò xīng xīng rù shuì ， zhè shì yī xiàng měi lì de zhí yè 。
sentences.english: The prince thought: Though absurd, this man lighting his lamp is like bringing a new star or flower to birth; extinguishing it puts them to sleep. That is a beautiful occupation.

sentences.chinese: “你好，为什么你刚把路灯熄灭，又立刻点亮它呢？”小王子问。“这是规定。”点灯人回答，“早上熄灯，晚上点灯。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， wèi shén me nǐ gāng bǎ lù dēng xī miè ， yòu lì kè diǎn liàng tā ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ zhè shì guī dìng 。 ” diǎn dēng rén huí dá ， “ zǎo shàng xī dēng ， wǎn shàng diǎn dēng 。 ”
sentences.english: "Good morning. Why did you just extinguish your lamp and then relight it?" "It is the orders," answered the lamplighter. "Extinguish in morning, light at night."

sentences.chinese: “可是为什么你一秒钟都不休息呢？”“因为星球一年比一年转得更快！现在它每分钟自转一周，我连一秒钟的睡眠都没有了！”
sentences.pinyin: “ kě shì wèi shén me nǐ yī miǎo zhōng dōu bù xiū xī ne ？ ” “ yīn wèi xīng qiú yī nián bǐ yī nián zhuǎn dé gèng kuài ！ xiàn zài tā měi fēn zhōng zì zhuǎn yī zhōu ， wǒ lián yī miǎo zhōng de shuì mián dōu méi yǒu le ！ ”
sentences.english: "Why do you not rest for a single second?" "Because the planet turns faster every year! Now it revolves once a minute, leaving me not a second of sleep!"

sentences.chinese: 小王子看着这位忠实坚守职责的人，心里充满了敬意：“在国王、虚荣者、酒鬼和商人眼中，这个人也许很可笑，但他却是唯一不只顾自己的人。他是我唯一想结交为朋友的人。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ kàn zhuó zhè wèi zhōng shí jiān shǒu zhí zé de rén ， xīn lǐ chōng mǎn le jìng yì ： “ zài guó wáng 、 xū róng zhě 、 jiǔ guǐ hé shāng rén yǎn zhōng ， zhè gè rén yě xǔ hěn kě xiào ， dàn tā què shì wéi yī bù zhǐ gù zì jǐ de rén 。 tā shì wǒ wéi yī xiǎng jié jiāo wèi péng yǒu de rén 。 ”
sentences.english: Looking at this faithful man, the prince felt deep respect: "The king, the conceited man, the tippler, and the businessman might despise him, yet he is the only one who cares for something other than himself. He is the only one I could have befriended."

title: 第十五章：第330号小行星：足不出户的地理学家
titleEn: Chapter 15: Asteroid 330: The Geographer & Ephemeral Rose

sentences.chinese: 第六颗行星比之前的要大十倍，上面住着一位正在撰写鸿篇巨著的老先生。
sentences.pinyin: dì liù kē xíng xīng bǐ zhī qián de yào dà shí bèi ， shàng miàn zhù zhuó yī wèi zhèng zài zhuàn xiě hóng piān jù zhuó de lǎo xiān shēng 。
sentences.english: The sixth planet was ten times larger, inhabited by an old gentleman writing voluminous books.

sentences.chinese: “看哪！来了一位探险家！”老人欢呼道。他是位地理学家。
sentences.pinyin: “ kàn nǎ ！ lái le yī wèi tàn xiǎn jiā ！ ” lǎo rén huān hū dào 。 tā shì wèi dì lǐ xué jiā 。
sentences.english: "Look! Here comes an explorer!" the old gentleman exclaimed. He was a geographer.

sentences.chinese: 小王子环顾四周：“你的星球真壮观啊！这里有海洋、高山和沙漠吗？”地理学家答道：“我不知道，因为我不是探险家。地理学家太重要了，不能到处闲逛，我们坐在办公室里记录探险家的报告。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ huán gù sì zhōu ： “ nǐ de xīng qiú zhēn zhuàng guān ā ！ zhè lǐ yǒu hǎi yáng 、 gāo shān hé shā mò ma ？ ” dì lǐ xué jiā dá dào ： “ wǒ bù zhī dào ， yīn wèi wǒ bù shì tàn xiǎn jiā 。 dì lǐ xué jiā tài zhòng yào le ， bù néng dào chù xián guàng ， wǒ mén zuò zài bàn gōng shì lǐ jì lù tàn xiǎn jiā de bào gào 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince looked around: "Your planet is magnificent! Are there oceans, mountains, and deserts?" "I cannot know," said the geographer, "for I am not an explorer. A geographer is too important to wander; we sit in offices recording explorers' findings."

sentences.chinese: 地理学家拿出大账本准备记录小王子的星球：“你有山脉和花朵吗？”小王子说：“我有三座火山，还有一朵花。”
sentences.pinyin: dì lǐ xué jiā ná chū dà zhàng běn zhǔn bèi jì lù xiǎo wáng zǐ de xīng qiú ： “ nǐ yǒu shān mài hé huā duǒ ma ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō ： “ wǒ yǒu sān zuò huǒ shān ， hái yǒu yī duǒ huā 。 ”
sentences.english: The geographer opened his ledger to record the prince's planet: "Do you have mountains and flowers?" "I have three volcanoes, and a flower," said the prince.

sentences.chinese: 地理学家摇头：“我们不记录花朵，因为花朵是‘转瞬即逝’的。”“‘转瞬即逝’是什么意思？”小王子追问。
sentences.pinyin: dì lǐ xué jiā yáo tóu ： “ wǒ mén bù jì lù huā duǒ ， yīn wèi huā duǒ shì ‘ zhuǎn shùn jí shì ’ de 。 ” “ ‘ zhuǎn shùn jí shì ’ shì shén me yì sī ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ zhuī wèn 。
sentences.english: The geographer shook his head: "We do not record flowers, because they are ephemeral." "What does ephemeral mean?" asked the prince.

sentences.chinese: “意思是说：它面临着很快消亡的危险。”小王子心中猛然一颤：“我的花儿是转瞬即逝的！她只有四根刺来抵抗整个世界，而我却把她孤零零地留在了家里！”这是小王子第一次感到由衷的懊悔。
sentences.pinyin: “ yì sī shì shuō ： tā miàn lín zhuó hěn kuài xiāo wáng de wēi xiǎn 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ xīn zhōng měng rán yī chàn ： “ wǒ de huā ér shì zhuǎn shùn jí shì de ！ tā zhǐ yǒu sì gēn cì lái dǐ kàng zhěng gè shì jiè ， ér wǒ què bǎ tā gū líng líng dì liú zài le jiā lǐ ！ ” zhè shì xiǎo wáng zǐ dì yī cì gǎn dào yóu zhōng de ào huǐ 。
sentences.english: "It means: that which is in danger of speedy disappearance." The prince felt a pang in his heart: "My flower is ephemeral! She has only four thorns to defend herself against the world, and I left her all alone at home!" For the first time, he felt deep regret.

sentences.chinese: 在地理学家的推荐下，小王子决定前往下一颗行星——地球。
sentences.pinyin: zài dì lǐ xué jiā de tuī jiàn xià ， xiǎo wáng zǐ jué dìng qián wǎng xià yī kē xíng xīng — — dì qiú 。
sentences.english: On the recommendation of the geographer, the little prince set off for his next destination: Earth.

title: 第十六章：第七颗行星：拥有二十亿大人的地球
titleEn: Chapter 16: The Seventh Planet: The Vast Earth

sentences.chinese: 第七颗行星就是地球。
sentences.pinyin: dì qī kē xíng xīng jiù shì dì qiú 。
sentences.english: The seventh planet, then, was the Earth.

sentences.chinese: 地球可不是一颗普普通通的行星！上面有一百一十一位国王、七千个地理学家、九十万个实业家、七百五十万个酒鬼和三亿一千一百万个虚荣者——也就是说，大约有二十亿个大人。
sentences.pinyin: dì qiú kě bù shì yī kē pǔ pǔ tōng tōng de xíng xīng ！ shàng miàn yǒu yī bǎi yī shí yī wèi guó wáng 、 qī qiān gè dì lǐ xué jiā 、 jiǔ shí wàn gè shí yè jiā 、 qī bǎi wǔ shí wàn gè jiǔ guǐ hé sān yì yī qiān yī bǎi wàn gè xū róng zhě — — yě jiù shì shuō ， dà yuē yǒu èr shí yì gè dà rén 。
sentences.english: The Earth is no ordinary planet! It counts 111 kings, 7,000 geographers, 900,000 businessmen, 7,500,000 tipplers, and 311,000,000 conceited men—about two billion grown-ups.

sentences.chinese: 在发明电灯之前，地球上的六大洲需要维持一支由四十六万二千五百一十一人组成的长明灯点灯大军，那场面壮观极了。
sentences.pinyin: zài fā míng diàn dēng zhī qián ， dì qiú shàng de liù dà zhōu xū yào wéi chí yī zhī yóu sì shí liù wàn èr qiān wǔ bǎi yī shí yī rén zǔ chéng de cháng míng dēng diǎn dēng dà jūn ， nà chǎng miàn zhuàng guān jí le 。
sentences.english: Before the invention of electricity, the six continents maintained a vast army of 462,511 lamplighters, creating a truly magnificent spectacle.

sentences.chinese: 然而，小王子踏上地球时，降落在了非洲广袤孤寂的撒哈拉沙漠上，那里一个人影也没有。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér ， xiǎo wáng zǐ tà shàng dì qiú shí ， jiàng luò zài le fēi zhōu guǎng mào gū jì de sā hā lā shā mò shàng ， nà lǐ yī gè rén yǐng yě méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: Yet when the little prince set foot upon the Earth, he landed in the vast, desolate sands of the African Sahara, without a single human soul in sight.

title: 第十七章：金黄毒蛇与孤独的谜语
titleEn: Chapter 17: The Golden Snake & Riddles in the Desert

sentences.chinese: 小王子站在金黄色的沙丘上，只看到一道月光般闪耀的金色绳索在沙中移动。那是一条毒蛇。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ zhàn zài jīn huáng sè de shā qiū shàng ， zhǐ kàn dào yī dào yuè guāng bān shǎn yào de jīn sè shéng suǒ zài shā zhōng yí dòng 。 nà shì yī tiáo dú shé 。
sentences.english: Standing upon the golden dunes, the prince saw only a moonlight-colored cord moving in the sand. It was a snake.

sentences.chinese: “晚上好，”小王子礼貌地说。“晚上好，”蛇说。“我落在什么星球上了？”小王子问。“在非洲的沙漠里，”蛇回答。
sentences.pinyin: “ wǎn shàng hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ lǐ mào dì shuō 。 “ wǎn shàng hǎo ， ” shé shuō 。 “ wǒ luò zài shén me xīng qiú shàng le ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ zài fēi zhōu de shā mò lǐ ， ” shé huí dá 。
sentences.english: "Good evening," said the prince politely. "Good evening," said the snake. "What planet have I fallen upon?" "In the desert of Africa," the snake replied.

sentences.chinese: 小王子在一块岩石上坐了下来：“在沙漠里真有点孤独……”蛇幽幽地说：“在人群中，你也一样会感到孤独。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ zài yī kuài yán shí shàng zuò le xià lái ： “ zài shā mò lǐ zhēn yǒu diǎn gū dú … … ” shé yōu yōu dì shuō ： “ zài rén qún zhōng ， nǐ yě yī yàng huì gǎn dào gū dú 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince sat upon a rock: "It is a little lonely in the desert..." The snake murmured: "It is also lonely among men."

sentences.chinese: 小王子看着这条细如手指的小动物：“你真弱小啊，连脚都没有。”蛇冷笑一声：“我比国王的手指更有力量。被我触碰过的人，都会回归他由之而来的尘土。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ kàn zhuó zhè tiáo xì rú shǒu zhǐ de xiǎo dòng wù ： “ nǐ zhēn ruò xiǎo ā ， lián jiǎo dōu méi yǒu 。 ” shé lěng xiào yī shēng ： “ wǒ bǐ guó wáng de shǒu zhǐ gèng yǒu lì liàng 。 bèi wǒ chù pèng guò de rén ， dōu huì huí guī tā yóu zhī ér lái de chén tǔ 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince looked at the slender creature: "You are very weak; you have no feet." The snake hissed softly: "I am more powerful than the finger of a king. Whomever I touch, I return to the earth from whence they came."

sentences.chinese: 蛇凝视着小王子纯洁的金发：“但我可怜你，你来自一颗纯净的星星。如果你哪天太思念你的故乡，我可以帮助你回去……”小王子懂得它的隐喻，默默地点了点头。
sentences.pinyin: shé níng shì zhuó xiǎo wáng zǐ chún jié de jīn fā ： “ dàn wǒ kě lián nǐ ， nǐ lái zì yī kē chún jìng de xīng xīng 。 rú guǒ nǐ nǎ tiān tài sī niàn nǐ de gù xiāng ， wǒ kě yǐ bāng zhù nǐ huí qù … … ” xiǎo wáng zǐ dǒng dé tā de yǐn yù ， mò mò dì diǎn le diǎn tóu 。
sentences.english: The snake gazed at his golden hair: "I feel pity for you, coming from a pure star. If one day you miss your planet too dearly, I can help you return..." The prince understood its riddle and nodded in silence.

title: 第十八章：沙漠中三片花瓣的孤单小花
titleEn: Chapter 18: The Desert Flower with Three Petals

sentences.chinese: 小王子穿过沙漠，一路上只遇到了一朵毫不起眼的三瓣小花。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ chuān guò shā mò ， yī lù shàng zhǐ yù dào le yī duǒ háo bù qǐ yǎn de sān bàn xiǎo huā 。
sentences.english: The little prince crossed the desert and met only one insignificant three-petaled flower.

sentences.chinese: “你好，”小王子说。“你好，”花儿说。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō 。 “ nǐ hǎo ， ” huā ér shuō 。
sentences.english: "Good morning," said the little prince. "Good morning," said the flower.

sentences.chinese: “请问人在哪里呢？”小王子礼貌地打听。
sentences.pinyin: “ qǐng wèn rén zài nǎ lǐ ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ lǐ mào dì dǎ tīng 。
sentences.english: "Where are the people?" the little prince asked politely.

sentences.chinese: 这朵花曾经见过一支经过沙漠的骆驼商队，便回答：“人吗？我想大概有六七个人吧，多年前我见过他们。但是谁也不知道该去哪里寻找他们，因为风吹着他们到处流浪。他们没有根，这让他们过得很艰难。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè duǒ huā céng jīng jiàn guò yī zhī jīng guò shā mò de luò tuó shāng duì ， biàn huí dá ： “ rén ma ？ wǒ xiǎng dà gài yǒu liù qī gè rén bā ， duō nián qián wǒ jiàn guò tā mén 。 dàn shì shuí yě bù zhī dào gāi qù nǎ lǐ xún zhǎo tā mén ， yīn wèi fēng chuī zhuó tā mén dào chù liú làng 。 tā mén méi yǒu gēn ， zhè ràng tā mén guò dé hěn jiān nán 。 ”
sentences.english: The flower had once seen a caravan pass by: "People? There are perhaps six or seven; I saw them years ago. But one never knows where to find them, for the wind carries them away. They have no roots, which makes life hard for them."

sentences.chinese: “再见，”小王子说。“再见，”小花轻声答道。
sentences.pinyin: “ zài jiàn ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō 。 “ zài jiàn ， ” xiǎo huā qīng shēng dá dào 。
sentences.english: "Goodbye," said the little prince. "Goodbye," whispered the little flower.

title: 第十九章：高山顶峰的回声与寂寞的呼喊
titleEn: Chapter 19: Echoes from the Mountain Summit

sentences.chinese: 小王子爬上了一座高耸入云的山峰。在他的星球上，除了膝盖高的三座火山外，他从未见过如此高大的山。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ pá shàng le yī zuò gāo sǒng rù yún de shān fēng 。 zài tā de xīng qiú shàng ， chú le xī gài gāo de sān zuò huǒ shān wài ， tā cóng wèi jiàn guò rú cǐ gāo dà de shān 。
sentences.english: The little prince climbed a high mountain. On his planet, the only mountains were his three knee-high volcanoes.

sentences.chinese: 他心想：“从这么高的山上，我一眼就能看清整个地球和所有的人了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn xiǎng ： “ cóng zhè me gāo de shān shàng ， wǒ yī yǎn jiù néng kàn qīng zhěng gè dì qiú hé suǒ yǒu de rén le 。 ”
sentences.english: He thought: "From a mountain this high, I will be able to see the entire Earth and all its people at a single glance."

sentences.chinese: 然而，放眼望去，除了陡峭尖锐的岩石峭壁，什么也没有。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér ， fàng yǎn wàng qù ， chú le dǒu qiào jiān ruì de yán shí qiào bì ， shén me yě méi yǒu 。
sentences.english: Yet looking out, he saw nothing but sharp, needle-like peaks of rock.

sentences.chinese: “你好！”小王子大声呼喊。“你好……你好……你好……”群山发出了清脆的回声。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ！ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ dà shēng hū hǎn 。 “ nǐ hǎo … … nǐ hǎo … … nǐ hǎo … … ” qún shān fā chū le qīng cuì de huí shēng 。
sentences.english: "Hello!" cried the little prince into the silence. "Hello... hello... hello..." the mountain echoes answered.

sentences.chinese: “你们是谁？”小王子问。“你们是谁……是谁……是谁……”回声重复着。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ mén shì shuí ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ nǐ mén shì shuí … … shì shuí … … shì shuí … … ” huí shēng chóng fù zhuó 。
sentences.english: "Who are you?" asked the little prince. "Who are you... who are you..." the echoes replied.

sentences.chinese: “请做我的朋友吧，我很孤独！”小王子恳求道。“我很孤独……孤独……孤独……”回声再次传来。
sentences.pinyin: “ qǐng zuò wǒ de péng yǒu bā ， wǒ hěn gū dú ！ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ kěn qiú dào 。 “ wǒ hěn gū dú … … gū dú … … gū dú … … ” huí shēng zài cì chuán lái 。
sentences.english: "Be my friends, I am all alone!" pleaded the prince. "I am all alone... alone... alone..." the echo repeated.

sentences.chinese: 小王子伤心地想：“这颗星球真是古怪，干燥、尖锐而且毫无想象力。人们只会重复别人说的话。而在我的家里，我的玫瑰总是第一个开口说话……”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ shāng xīn dì xiǎng ： “ zhè kē xīng qiú zhēn shì gǔ guài ， gān zào 、 jiān ruì ér qiě háo wú xiǎng xiàng lì 。 rén mén zhǐ huì chóng fù bié rén shuō de huà 。 ér zài wǒ de jiā lǐ ， wǒ de méi guī zǒng shì dì yī gè kāi kǒu shuō huà … … ”
sentences.english: The prince thought sadly: "What a strange planet! Dry, pointed, and lacking imagination. People only repeat what is said to them. While at home, my rose always spoke first..."

title: 第二十章：盛开五千朵玫瑰的花园与破碎的心
titleEn: Chapter 20: The Garden of Five Thousand Roses

sentences.chinese: 小王子在沙漠、岩石与积雪中走了很久很久，终于发现了一条道路。所有的道路都是通向人群的。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ zài shā mò 、 yán shí yǔ jī xuě zhōng zǒu le hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ ， zhōng yú fā xiàn le yī tiáo dào lù 。 suǒ yǒu de dào lù dōu shì tōng xiàng rén qún de 。
sentences.english: After walking a long time through sand, rocks, and snow, the little prince at last came upon a road. All roads lead to humanity.

sentences.chinese: 他走到了一个盛开着五千朵玫瑰的花园前。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu dào le yī gè shèng kāi zhuó wǔ qiān duǒ méi guī de huā yuán qián 。
sentences.english: He found himself standing before a garden filled with five thousand blooming roses.

sentences.chinese: “你好，”小王子惊呆了。五千朵花齐声回答：“你好。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ jīng dāi le 。 wǔ qiān duǒ huā qí shēng huí dá ： “ nǐ hǎo 。 ”
sentences.english: "Good morning," gasped the little prince. "Good morning," replied the roses in unison.

sentences.chinese: 小王子凝视着她们：她们每一朵都和自己星球上的那一朵长得一模一样！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ níng shì zhuó tā mén ： tā mén měi yī duǒ dōu hé zì jǐ xīng qiú shàng de nà yī duǒ cháng dé yī mó yī yàng ！
sentences.english: The prince stared at them: every single one was identical to the flower on his own planet!

sentences.chinese: “你们是谁？”他颤抖着问。“我们是玫瑰花。”花儿们骄傲地回答。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ mén shì shuí ？ ” tā chàn dǒu zhuó wèn 。 “ wǒ mén shì méi guī huā 。 ” huā ér mén jiāo ào dì huí dá 。
sentences.english: "Who are you?" he asked, trembling. "We are roses," the flowers answered with pride.

sentences.chinese: 小王子感到万分悲伤。他的玫瑰曾经告诉他，她是全宇宙中独一无二的奇迹，而这里仅仅一座花园里就有整整五千朵完全相同的花！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ gǎn dào wàn fēn bēi shāng 。 tā de méi guī céng jīng gào sù tā ， tā shì quán yǔ zhòu zhōng dú yī wú èr de qí jì ， ér zhè lǐ jǐn jǐn yī zuò huā yuán lǐ jiù yǒu zhěng zhěng wǔ qiān duǒ wán quán xiāng tóng de huā ！
sentences.english: The little prince felt overwhelmed with grief. His rose had told him she was the only one of her kind in the universe, yet here were five thousand in a single garden!

sentences.chinese: “如果她看到这些，一定会羞愤得咳嗽并装死来掩饰自己的难堪。而我还以为自己拥有一朵无可比拟的绝世珍宝，原来我拥有的不过是一朵普通的玫瑰和三座膝盖高的火山。”小王子趴在草地上，伤心地痛哭起来。
sentences.pinyin: “ rú guǒ tā kàn dào zhè xiē ， yī dìng huì xiū fèn dé ké sòu bìng zhuāng sǐ lái yǎn shì zì jǐ de nán kān 。 ér wǒ hái yǐ wèi zì jǐ yōng yǒu yī duǒ wú kě bǐ nǐ de jué shì zhēn bǎo ， yuán lái wǒ yōng yǒu de bù guò shì yī duǒ pǔ tōng de méi guī hé sān zuò xī gài gāo de huǒ shān 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ pā zài cǎo dì shàng ， shāng xīn dì tòng kū qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: "If she saw this, she would cough terribly and pretend to die to escape ridicule. And I thought I was rich with a unique flower, when I possessed only a common rose and three knee-high volcanoes." He lay down in the grass and wept.

title: 第二十一章：狐狸的智慧与“驯服”的秘密：唯用心方能看清
titleEn: Chapter 21: The Fox & The Secret: Only the Heart Sees Rightly

sentences.chinese: 就在这时，一只狐狸出现了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí ， yī zhǐ hú lí chū xiàn le 。
sentences.english: It was at this moment that the fox appeared.

sentences.chinese: “你好，”狐狸说。“你好，”小王子有礼貌地回答，转过身来却什么也没看见。“我在这里，在苹果树下。”声音说。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， ” hú lí shuō 。 “ nǐ hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ yǒu lǐ mào dì huí dá ， zhuǎn guò shēn lái què shén me yě méi kàn jiàn 。 “ wǒ zài zhè lǐ ， zài píng guǒ shù xià 。 ” shēng yīn shuō 。
sentences.english: "Good morning," said the fox. "Good morning," answered the little prince, turning around but seeing nothing. "Here I am, under the apple tree."

sentences.chinese: “过来和我一起玩吧，”小王子提议道，“我正难过得要命……”“我不能和你一起玩，”狐狸说，“我还没有被驯服呢。”
sentences.pinyin: “ guò lái hé wǒ yī qǐ wán bā ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ tí yì dào ， “ wǒ zhèng nán guò dé yào mìng … … ” “ wǒ bù néng hé nǐ yī qǐ wán ， ” hú lí shuō ， “ wǒ hái méi yǒu bèi xùn fú ne 。 ”
sentences.english: "Come play with me," the prince proposed, "I am terribly sad..." "I cannot play with you," said the fox, "I am not tamed."

sentences.chinese: “‘驯服’是什么意思？”小王子问。“这是常常被遗忘的事情，”狐狸说，“它的意思是‘建立羁绊’。”
sentences.pinyin: “ ‘ xùn fú ’ shì shén me yì sī ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ zhè shì cháng cháng bèi yí wàng de shì qíng ， ” hú lí shuō ， “ tā de yì sī shì ‘ jiàn lì jī bàn ’ 。 ”
sentences.english: "What does 'tamed' mean?" asked the prince. "It is an act too often neglected," said the fox, "it means 'to establish ties.'"

sentences.chinese: “建立羁绊？”“对，”狐狸说，“对我来说，你现在只是一个和成千上万个男孩子一模一样的小男孩，我不需要你，你也不需要我。但如果你驯服了我，我们就会彼此需要。对我而言，你就是全宇宙独一无二的；对你而言，我也是全宇宙独一无二的了……”
sentences.pinyin: “ jiàn lì jī bàn ？ ” “ duì ， ” hú lí shuō ， “ duì wǒ lái shuō ， nǐ xiàn zài zhǐ shì yī gè hé chéng qiān shàng wàn gè nán hái zǐ yī mó yī yàng de xiǎo nán hái ， wǒ bù xū yào nǐ ， nǐ yě bù xū yào wǒ 。 dàn rú guǒ nǐ xùn fú le wǒ ， wǒ mén jiù huì bǐ cǐ xū yào 。 duì wǒ ér yán ， nǐ jiù shì quán yǔ zhòu dú yī wú èr de ； duì nǐ ér yán ， wǒ yě shì quán yǔ zhòu dú yī wú èr de le … … ”
sentences.english: "Establish ties?" "Yes," said the fox, "To me, you are still only a little boy like a hundred thousand other boys. But if you tame me, we shall need each other. To me you will be unique in all the world; to you I shall be unique in all the world..."

sentences.chinese: 小王子恍然大悟：“我开始明白了……有一朵花……我想她已经驯服了我。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ huǎng rán dà wù ： “ wǒ kāi shǐ míng bái le … … yǒu yī duǒ huā … … wǒ xiǎng tā yǐ jīng xùn fú le wǒ 。 ”
sentences.english: The little prince whispered softly: "I begin to understand... there is a flower... I think she has tamed me."

sentences.chinese: 狐狸继续说：“我的生活很单调。但如果你驯服了我，我的生命就如同充满阳光。金黄色的麦田虽然我吃不了面包，但每当我看到麦浪，我就会想起你金黄色的头发，我甚至会爱上听风吹麦浪的声音……”
sentences.pinyin: hú lí jì xù shuō ： “ wǒ de shēng huó hěn dān tiáo 。 dàn rú guǒ nǐ xùn fú le wǒ ， wǒ de shēng mìng jiù rú tóng chōng mǎn yáng guāng 。 jīn huáng sè de mài tián suī rán wǒ chī bù le miàn bāo ， dàn měi dāng wǒ kàn dào mài làng ， wǒ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ nǐ jīn huáng sè de tóu fā ， wǒ shèn zhì huì ài shàng tīng fēng chuī mài làng de shēng yīn … … ”
sentences.english: The fox continued: "My life is monotonous. But if you tame me, sunshine will illuminate my days. Wheat fields will remind me of your golden hair, and I will love the sound of wind in the wheat..."

sentences.chinese: 小王子驯服了狐狸。当分别的时刻到来时，狐狸哭了。小王子说：“这都是你的错，我本不想伤害你，但你偏要我驯服你！”狐狸说：“是的，但麦田的颜色给了我安慰。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ xùn fú le hú lí 。 dāng fēn bié de shí kè dào lái shí ， hú lí kū le 。 xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō ： “ zhè dōu shì nǐ de cuò ， wǒ běn bù xiǎng shāng hài nǐ ， dàn nǐ piān yào wǒ xùn fú nǐ ！ ” hú lí shuō ： “ shì de ， dàn mài tián de yán sè gěi le wǒ ān wèi 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince tamed the fox. When the hour of departure drew near, the fox wept. The prince said: "It is your own fault, I wished you no harm!" The fox said: "Yes, but look at the color of the wheat fields; it brings me comfort."

sentences.chinese: 狐狸送给小王子一个秘密作为临别礼物：“这是我的秘密，它极其简单：唯有用心灵才能看得清事物的本质，真正重要的东西，用肉眼是看不见的。”
sentences.pinyin: hú lí sòng gěi xiǎo wáng zǐ yī gè mì mì zuò wéi lín bié lǐ wù ： “ zhè shì wǒ de mì mì ， tā jí qí jiǎn dān ： wéi yǒu yòng xīn líng cái néng kàn dé qīng shì wù de běn zhì ， zhēn zhèng zhòng yào de dōng xī ， yòng ròu yǎn shì kàn bù jiàn de 。 ”
sentences.english: The fox gave the prince a secret parting gift: "Here is my secret, very simple: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye."

sentences.chinese: “正是你为你的玫瑰付出的时间与心血，才使你的玫瑰变得如此重要。你必须对你驯服过的一切永远负责，你对你的玫瑰负有责任。”小王子默默地把这些话牢牢记在心底。
sentences.pinyin: “ zhèng shì nǐ wèi nǐ de méi guī fù chū de shí jiān yǔ xīn xuè ， cái shǐ nǐ de méi guī biàn dé rú cǐ zhòng yào 。 nǐ bì xū duì nǐ xùn fú guò de yī qiē yǒng yuǎn fù zé ， nǐ duì nǐ de méi guī fù yǒu zé rèn 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ mò mò dì bǎ zhè xiē huà láo láo jì zài xīn dǐ 。
sentences.english: "It is the time you have wasted for your rose that makes your rose so important. You become responsible forever for what you have tamed. You are responsible for your rose." The little prince repeated, cementing it in his soul.

title: 第二十二章：铁道扳道工与不知去向的急促旅客
titleEn: Chapter 22: The Railway Switchman & Restless Travelers

sentences.chinese: “你好，”小王子说。“你好，”扳道工说。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō 。 “ nǐ hǎo ， ” bān dào gōng shuō 。
sentences.english: "Good morning," said the little prince. "Good morning," said the switchman.

sentences.chinese: “你在这里做什么呢？”小王子问。“我把旅客分批送上列车，”扳道工回答，“把载着他们的火车送往右边，或者送往左边。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ zài zhè lǐ zuò shén me ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ wǒ bǎ lǚ kè fēn pī sòng shàng liè chē ， ” bān dào gōng huí dá ， “ bǎ zài zhuó tā mén de huǒ chē sòng wǎng yòu biān ， huò zhě sòng wǎng zuǒ biān 。 ”
sentences.english: "What do you do here?" asked the prince. "I sort out travelers by packets of a thousand," said the switchman, "sending trains right or left."

sentences.chinese: 一列灯火通明的快车雷鸣般疾驰而过，把扳道工的小屋震得摇摇晃晃。“他们走得真急啊，”小王子问，“他们在寻找什么呢？”
sentences.pinyin: yī liè dēng huǒ tōng míng de kuài chē léi míng bān jí chí ér guò ， bǎ bān dào gōng de xiǎo wū zhèn dé yáo yáo huǎng huǎng 。 “ tā mén zǒu dé zhēn jí ā ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn ， “ tā mén zài xún zhǎo shén me ne ？ ”
sentences.english: A brilliantly lighted express train roared by like thunder, shaking the cabin. "They are in a great hurry," said the prince, "what are they seeking?"

sentences.chinese: “开火车的司机自己也不知道。”扳道工回答。
sentences.pinyin: “ kāi huǒ chē de sī jī zì jǐ yě bù zhī dào 。 ” bān dào gōng huí dá 。
sentences.english: "Even the engine driver does not know," said the switchman.

sentences.chinese: 第二列快车又反方向轰鸣而过。“他们已经回来了吗？”小王子问。“不，这是另外一批人，他们在换车。”
sentences.pinyin: dì èr liè kuài chē yòu fǎn fāng xiàng hōng míng ér guò 。 “ tā mén yǐ jīng huí lái le ma ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ bù ， zhè shì lìng wài yī pī rén ， tā mén zài huàn chē 。 ”
sentences.english: A second express train roared by in the opposite direction. "Are they already coming back?" asked the prince. "No, these are different travelers swapping places."

sentences.chinese: “他们对原来住的地方不满意吗？”“人永远不会对自己所处的地方感到满足。”扳道工叹道。
sentences.pinyin: “ tā mén duì yuán lái zhù de dì fāng bù mǎn yì ma ？ ” “ rén yǒng yuǎn bù huì duì zì jǐ suǒ chù de dì fāng gǎn dào mǎn zú 。 ” bān dào gōng tàn dào 。
sentences.english: "Were they not satisfied where they were?" "No one is ever satisfied where they are," sighed the switchman.

sentences.chinese: 小王子看着疾驰的列车：“只有小孩子把鼻子贴在车窗上往外看，只有他们懂得自己在寻找什么。他们会为一只布娃娃哭泣，娃娃便成了他们最重要的宝贝。”扳道工羡慕地说：“他们真幸运。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ kàn zhuó jí chí de liè chē ： “ zhǐ yǒu xiǎo hái zǐ bǎ bí zǐ tiē zài chē chuāng shàng wǎng wài kàn ， zhǐ yǒu tā mén dǒng dé zì jǐ zài xún zhǎo shén me 。 tā mén huì wèi yī zhǐ bù wá wá kū qì ， wá wá biàn chéng le tā mén zuì zhòng yào de bǎo bèi 。 ” bān dào gōng xiàn mù dì shuō ： “ tā mén zhēn xìng yùn 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince watched the train: "Only the children flatten their noses against the windowpanes. Only they know what they are looking for. They waste time over a rag doll and it becomes important." The switchman said: "They are the lucky ones."

title: 第二十三章：贩卖解渴药丸的商贩与五十三分钟
titleEn: Chapter 23: The Merchant Selling Thirst Pills

sentences.chinese: “你好，”小王子说。“你好，”商贩说。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ hǎo ， ” xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō 。 “ nǐ hǎo ， ” shāng fàn shuō 。
sentences.english: "Good morning," said the little prince. "Good morning," said the merchant.

sentences.chinese: 这是一个贩卖特制止渴药丸的商贩。只要每周吞下一粒药丸，人就再也不需要喝水了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yī gè fàn mài tè zhì zhǐ kě yào wán de shāng fàn 。 zhǐ yào měi zhōu tūn xià yī lì yào wán ， rén jiù zài yě bù xū yào hē shuǐ le 。
sentences.english: He was a merchant who sold pills devised to quench thirst. Swallow one a week and you no longer feel the need to drink.

sentences.chinese: “你为什么卖这个东西呢？”小王子好奇地问。
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ wèi shén me mài zhè gè dōng xī ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ hào qí dì wèn 。
sentences.english: "Why do you sell those?" asked the little prince.

sentences.chinese: “这能节省大量的宝贵时间，”商贩精明地算计道，“专家计算过，每周能节省五十三分钟呢！”
sentences.pinyin: “ zhè néng jié shěng dà liàng de bǎo guì shí jiān ， ” shāng fàn jīng míng dì suàn jì dào ， “ zhuān jiā jì suàn guò ， měi zhōu néng jié shěng wǔ shí sān fēn zhōng ne ！ ”
sentences.english: "Because it saves a tremendous amount of time," the merchant computed. "Experts calculate it saves fifty-three minutes a week!"

sentences.chinese: “那么节省出来的五十三分钟用来做什么呢？”小王子问。“随你喜欢做什么就做什么。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nà me jié shěng chū lái de wǔ shí sān fēn zhōng yòng lái zuò shén me ne ？ ” xiǎo wáng zǐ wèn 。 “ suí nǐ xǐ huān zuò shén me jiù zuò shén me 。 ”
sentences.english: "And what does one do with those fifty-three minutes?" "Whatever one likes."

sentences.chinese: 小王子心想：“如果我有五十三分钟可以自由支配，我会悠闲自得地迈开步子，慢慢走向一眼清澈甘甜的水泉……”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ xīn xiǎng ： “ rú guǒ wǒ yǒu wǔ shí sān fēn zhōng kě yǐ zì yóu zhī pèi ， wǒ huì yōu xián zì dé dì mài kāi bù zǐ ， màn màn zǒu xiàng yī yǎn qīng chè gān tián de shuǐ quán … … ”
sentences.english: The little prince said to himself: "As for me, if I had fifty-three minutes to spend as I liked, I would walk quite slowly toward a freshwater spring..."

title: 第二十四章：沙漠深处的寻泉之旅与使沙漠美丽的秘密
titleEn: Chapter 24: Searching for the Well & Secret Beauty of the Desert

sentences.chinese: 这是飞机在沙漠中抛锚后的第八天。我听着卖药丸商贩的故事，喝下了最后一滴救命的水。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì fēi jī zài shā mò zhōng pāo máo hòu de dì bā tiān 。 wǒ tīng zhuó mài yào wán shāng fàn de gù shì ， hē xià le zuì hòu yī dī jiù mìng de shuǐ 。
sentences.english: It was now the eighth day since my engine broke down in the desert, and I was listening to the merchant story while drinking the last drop of water.

sentences.chinese: 我对小王子说：“你讲的这些回忆真美，但我还没修好飞机，而且我们已经没有水喝了，要是能慢慢走向水泉该多好啊！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì xiǎo wáng zǐ shuō ： “ nǐ jiǎng de zhè xiē huí yì zhēn měi ， dàn wǒ hái méi xiū hǎo fēi jī ， ér qiě wǒ mén yǐ jīng méi yǒu shuǐ hē le ， yào shì néng màn màn zǒu xiàng shuǐ quán gāi duō hǎo ā ！ ”
sentences.english: I told the prince: "Your memories are charming, but my plane is still broken and I have nothing left to drink; I too would love to walk slowly toward a spring!"

sentences.chinese: 小王子提议：“我们也去找一口水井吧……”在无边无际的沙漠里盲目寻找水井看似疯狂，但我们还是在落日中启程了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ tí yì ： “ wǒ mén yě qù zhǎo yī kǒu shuǐ jǐng bā … … ” zài wú biān wú jì de shā mò lǐ máng mù xún zhǎo shuǐ jǐng kàn sì fēng kuáng ， dàn wǒ mén hái shì zài luò rì zhōng qǐ chéng le 。
sentences.english: The prince suggested: "Let us go look for a well..." Though searching blindly across endless sands seemed absurd, we set off into the setting sun.

sentences.chinese: 夜幕降临，繁星点点，小王子走累了，坐了下来。他说：“沙漠之所以美丽，是因为在某个角落里，藏着一口清泉……”
sentences.pinyin: yè mù jiàng lín ， fán xīng diǎn diǎn ， xiǎo wáng zǐ zǒu léi le ， zuò le xià lái 。 tā shuō ： “ shā mò zhī suǒ yǐ měi lì ， shì yīn wèi zài mǒu gè jiǎo luò lǐ ， cáng zhuó yī kǒu qīng quán … … ”
sentences.english: Night fell and the stars began to shine. Tired, the prince sat down: "What makes the desert beautiful is that somewhere it hides a well..."

sentences.chinese: 我突然心头一震，顿悟了这个神秘的真理。无论是房屋、星星还是沙漠，使它们美丽的，都是肉眼看不见的东西！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tū rán xīn tóu yī zhèn ， dùn wù le zhè gè shén mì de zhēn lǐ 。 wú lùn shì fáng wū 、 xīng xīng hái shì shā mò ， shǐ tā mén měi lì de ， dōu shì ròu yǎn kàn bù jiàn de dōng xī ！
sentences.english: I was struck by sudden realization of this luminous truth. Whether a house, stars, or the desert, what makes them beautiful is invisible!

sentences.chinese: 小王子睡着了。我把他抱在怀里，在月光下继续前行。看着他金黄色的头发在夜风中轻拂，我深受感动：我所看到的只是一个外壳，最重要的东西是看不见的。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ shuì zhuó le 。 wǒ bǎ tā bào zài huái lǐ ， zài yuè guāng xià jì xù qián xíng 。 kàn zhuó tā jīn huáng sè de tóu fā zài yè fēng zhōng qīng fú ， wǒ shēn shòu gǎn dòng ： wǒ suǒ kàn dào de zhǐ shì yī gè wài ké ， zuì zhòng yào de dōng xī shì kàn bù jiàn de 。
sentences.english: The little prince fell asleep. I took him in my arms and walked under the moon. Looking at his golden hair in the breeze, I was deeply moved: what I see is only a shell; what is most important is invisible.

title: 第二十五章：甘甜如礼物的清泉水与羊嘴套的约定
titleEn: Chapter 25: The Sweet Water of the Well & The Muzzle

sentences.chinese: 拂晓时分，我们终于发现了一口水井。那不是沙漠里常见的简陋水坑，而是一口如同撒哈拉村庄里的古老石头水井。
sentences.pinyin: fú xiǎo shí fēn ， wǒ mén zhōng yú fā xiàn le yī kǒu shuǐ jǐng 。 nà bù shì shā mò lǐ cháng jiàn de jiǎn lòu shuǐ kēng ， ér shì yī kǒu rú tóng sā hā lā cūn zhuāng lǐ de gǔ lǎo shí tóu shuǐ jǐng 。
sentences.english: At daybreak, we discovered a well. It was not a crude hole in the sand, but an ancient stone well like those in rural villages.

sentences.chinese: 滑轮、水桶和绳索一应俱全。我转动生锈的滑轮，滑轮像一架沉睡已久的老风车一样欢唱起来。
sentences.pinyin: huá lún 、 shuǐ tǒng hé shéng suǒ yī yīng jù quán 。 wǒ zhuàn dòng shēng xiù de huá lún ， huá lún xiàng yī jià chén shuì yǐ jiǔ de lǎo fēng chē yī yàng huān chàng qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: Everything was ready: pulley, bucket, and rope. I turned the rusty wheel, and it sang like an old weather vane waking from long slumber.

sentences.chinese: 我把沉甸甸的水桶提到井沿上，小王子轻声说：“我渴望喝这水，请让我喝一口吧……”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎ chén diàn diàn de shuǐ tǒng tí dào jǐng yán shàng ， xiǎo wáng zǐ qīng shēng shuō ： “ wǒ kě wàng hē zhè shuǐ ， qǐng ràng wǒ hē yī kǒu bā … … ”
sentences.english: I hoisted the full bucket to the stone rim. The little prince whispered: "I thirst for this water; give me some to drink..."

sentences.chinese: 我把水桶送到他的唇边。他闭着眼睛，大口大口地畅饮着。这水甘甜如蜜，它不是普通的养分，它诞生于星空下的跋涉、滑轮的歌唱以及我双臂的劳作，它对心灵而言就像是一份美好的节日礼物。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎ shuǐ tǒng sòng dào tā de chún biān 。 tā bì zhuó yǎn jīng ， dà kǒu dà kǒu dì chàng yǐn zhuó 。 zhè shuǐ gān tián rú mì ， tā bù shì pǔ tōng de yǎng fēn ， tā dàn shēng yú xīng kōng xià de bá shè 、 huá lún de gē chàng yǐ jí wǒ shuāng bì de láo zuò ， tā duì xīn líng ér yán jiù xiàng shì yī fèn měi hǎo de jié rì lǐ wù 。
sentences.english: I lifted it to his lips. He drank with closed eyes. This water was sweet as a feast, born of our walk under stars, the pulley’s song, and the labor of my arms—it was like a gift to the heart.

sentences.chinese: 小王子擦了擦嘴角说：“你这里的人，在一个花园里种五千朵玫瑰，却找不到他们寻觅的东西……其实他们所寻找的，只要在一朵玫瑰花或一滴水中就能找到。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ cā le cā zuǐ jiǎo shuō ： “ nǐ zhè lǐ de rén ， zài yī gè huā yuán lǐ zhǒng wǔ qiān duǒ méi guī ， què zhǎo bù dào tā mén xún mì de dōng xī … … qí shí tā mén suǒ xún zhǎo de ， zhǐ yào zài yī duǒ méi guī huā huò yī dī shuǐ zhōng jiù néng zhǎo dào 。 ”
sentences.english: The prince smiled: "People on your planet cultivate five thousand roses in one garden, yet never find what they seek... and yet what they seek could be found in a single rose or a drop of water."

sentences.chinese: 他提醒我：“你答应过我的……请为我的小羊画一个嘴套，我要保护好我的玫瑰花。”我取出画笔，为他画好了嘴套，心中却隐隐作痛。
sentences.pinyin: tā tí xǐng wǒ ： “ nǐ dā yìng guò wǒ de … … qǐng wèi wǒ de xiǎo yáng huà yī gè zuǐ tào ， wǒ yào bǎo hù hǎo wǒ de méi guī huā 。 ” wǒ qǔ chū huà bǐ ， wèi tā huà hǎo le zuǐ tào ， xīn zhōng què yǐn yǐn zuò tòng 。
sentences.english: He reminded me gently: "You promised... please draw a muzzle for my sheep, to protect my flower." I drew the muzzle, but my heart tightened with quiet apprehension.

title: 第二十六章：毒蛇的致命信诺与小王子的回归
titleEn: Chapter 26: The Snake's Bite & Return to the Stars

sentences.chinese: 在水井旁边，有一堵坍塌的古老石墙。第二天傍晚我修好飞机走回水井时，远远看到小王子坐在墙头。
sentences.pinyin: zài shuǐ jǐng páng biān ， yǒu yī dǔ tān tā de gǔ lǎo shí qiáng 。 dì èr tiān bàng wǎn wǒ xiū hǎo fēi jī zǒu huí shuǐ jǐng shí ， yuǎn yuǎn kàn dào xiǎo wáng zǐ zuò zài qiáng tóu 。
sentences.english: Beside the well stood the ruins of an ancient stone wall. The next evening, having repaired my plane, I saw the prince sitting atop the wall.

sentences.chinese: 我听到他在同什么人说话：“你的毒性真的灵验吗？你确定不会让我痛苦太久吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng dào tā zài tóng shén me rén shuō huà ： “ nǐ de dú xìng zhēn de líng yàn ma ？ nǐ què dìng bù huì ràng wǒ tòng kǔ tài jiǔ ma ？ ”
sentences.english: I heard him speaking to someone: "Is your poison truly good? Are you sure it will not make me suffer long?"

sentences.chinese: 我急忙赶上前去，只见一条黄色的剧毒沙蛇正对着小王子抬起头。我拔出手枪冲过去，蛇迅速溜进了石缝里。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jí máng gǎn shàng qián qù ， zhǐ jiàn yī tiáo huáng sè de jù dú shā shé zhèng duì zhuó xiǎo wáng zǐ tái qǐ tóu 。 wǒ bá chū shǒu qiāng chōng guò qù ， shé xùn sù liū jìn le shí féng lǐ 。
sentences.english: I rushed forward and saw a yellow desert snake rearing up toward him. As I drew my revolver, the snake darted into the stones with a faint metallic sound.

sentences.chinese: 小王子脸色苍白地倒在我怀里。他抚摸着我冰冷的手：“我很高兴你修好了发动机，你终于可以回家了。今天夜里，我也要回家了……”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng zǐ liǎn sè cāng bái dì dǎo zài wǒ huái lǐ 。 tā fǔ mō zhuó wǒ bīng lěng de shǒu ： “ wǒ hěn gāo xìng nǐ xiū hǎo le fā dòng jī ， nǐ zhōng yú kě yǐ huí jiā le 。 jīn tiān yè lǐ ， wǒ yě yào huí jiā le … … ”
sentences.english: The prince fell pale into my arms. He touched my hand: "I am glad you found what was wrong with your engine; you can go home. Tonight, I too am going home..."

sentences.chinese: “那里太远了，我不能带走这副沉重的躯壳，它太重了。”小王子看着夜空，“今夜我的那颗星星，正好会出现在我一年前坠落的地方的正上方。”
sentences.pinyin: “ nà lǐ tài yuǎn le ， wǒ bù néng dài zǒu zhè fù chén zhòng de qū qiào ， tā tài zhòng le 。 ” xiǎo wáng zǐ kàn zhuó yè kōng ， “ jīn yè wǒ de nà kē xīng xīng ， zhèng hǎo huì chū xiàn zài wǒ yī nián qián zhuì luò de dì fāng de zhèng shàng fāng 。 ”
sentences.english: "It is much too far. I cannot carry this heavy body; it is too heavy." The prince gazed at the stars: "Tonight, my star will be right above where I fell one year ago."

sentences.chinese: “你知道吗？当你在夜晚仰望星空时，因为我就住在其中一颗星星上，因为我在其中一颗星星上欢笑，所以在你看来，就像所有的星星都在对你微笑一样！你将拥有五亿个会笑的小铃铛！”
sentences.pinyin: “ nǐ zhī dào ma ？ dāng nǐ zài yè wǎn yǎng wàng xīng kōng shí ， yīn wèi wǒ jiù zhù zài qí zhōng yī kē xīng xīng shàng ， yīn wèi wǒ zài qí zhōng yī kē xīng xīng shàng huān xiào ， suǒ yǐ zài nǐ kàn lái ， jiù xiàng suǒ yǒu de xīng xīng dōu zài duì nǐ wēi xiào yī yàng ！ nǐ jiāng yōng yǒu wǔ yì gè huì xiào de xiǎo líng dāng ！ ”
sentences.english: "You know... when you look at the sky at night, since I will live in one of them, since I will laugh in one of them, it will seem to you as if all the stars were laughing! You alone will have stars that know how to laugh!"

sentences.chinese: 午夜时分，小王子独自走向沙丘。一道黄色的闪光在它的脚踝边闪过，他没有发出一声尖叫，像一棵小树一样轻轻倒在柔软的沙地上，甚至没有发出一丝声响。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ yè shí fēn ， xiǎo wáng zǐ dú zì zǒu xiàng shā qiū 。 yī dào huáng sè de shǎn guāng zài tā de jiǎo huái biān shǎn guò ， tā méi yǒu fā chū yī shēng jiān jiào ， xiàng yī kē xiǎo shù yī yàng qīng qīng dǎo zài róu ruǎn de shā dì shàng ， shèn zhì méi yǒu fā chū yī sī shēng xiǎng 。
sentences.english: At midnight, the prince walked softly into the dunes. A yellow flash gleamed near his ankle. He did not cry out; he fell gently as a tree falls on soft sand, making not a sound.

title: 第二十七章：遥望星空：五亿颗会笑的小铃铛
titleEn: Chapter 27: Stargazing: Five Hundred Million Laughing Bells

sentences.chinese: 如今，整整六年过去了。我从未向任何人讲过这个故事。同伴们为我能够生还归来而欣喜万分。
sentences.pinyin: rú jīn ， zhěng zhěng liù nián guò qù le 。 wǒ cóng wèi xiàng rèn hé rén jiǎng guò zhè gè gù shì 。 tóng bàn mén wèi wǒ néng gòu shēng hái guī lái ér xīn xǐ wàn fēn 。
sentences.english: Now, six full years have passed. I have never told this story before. My companions were overjoyed to see me alive.

sentences.chinese: 我知道小王子已经回到了他的星球，因为第二天清晨，我在沙滩上没有找到他的躯体。那具躯体其实并不沉重。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào xiǎo wáng zǐ yǐ jīng huí dào le tā de xīng qiú ， yīn wèi dì èr tiān qīng chén ， wǒ zài shā tān shàng méi yǒu zhǎo dào tā de qū tǐ 。 nà jù qū tǐ qí shí bìng bù chén zhòng 。
sentences.english: I know he returned to his planet, because at dawn I did not find his body in the sand. It was not such a heavy body.

sentences.chinese: 每当我夜里仰望繁星，我都感到无比甜美。我倾听着那五亿颗宛如小铃铛般清脆欢笑的星星。
sentences.pinyin: měi dāng wǒ yè lǐ yǎng wàng fán xīng ， wǒ dōu gǎn dào wú bǐ tián měi 。 wǒ qīng tīng zhuó nà wǔ yì kē wǎn rú xiǎo líng dāng bān qīng cuì huān xiào de xīng xīng 。
sentences.english: Whenever I listen to the stars at night, it is sweet. I listen to those five hundred million little bells ringing with laughter.

sentences.chinese: 但有时我也会感到深深的忧虑：我给小羊画的皮嘴套，忘记画皮带了！它永远也系不上！羊会不会在不经意间把那朵玫瑰花吃掉了呢？
sentences.pinyin: dàn yǒu shí wǒ yě huì gǎn dào shēn shēn de yōu lǜ ： wǒ gěi xiǎo yáng huà de pí zuǐ tào ， wàng jì huà pí dài le ！ tā yǒng yuǎn yě xì bù shàng ！ yáng huì bù huì zài bù jīng yì jiān bǎ nà duǒ méi guī huā chī diào le ne ？
sentences.english: Yet sometimes fear grips me: on the leather muzzle I drew, I forgot to add the fastening strap! Did the sheep eat the flower unawares?

sentences.chinese: 这真是一个深不可测的谜题。对于深爱着小王子的你们和崇敬着他的我来说，天上的某处，一朵我们从未见过的玫瑰花，究竟是安然无恙，还是已经被一只小羊吃掉，宇宙的一切都会因此而彻底改变！
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhēn shì yī gè shēn bù kě cè de mí tí 。 duì yú shēn ài zhuó xiǎo wáng zǐ de nǐ mén hé chóng jìng zhuó tā de wǒ lái shuō ， tiān shàng de mǒu chù ， yī duǒ wǒ mén cóng wèi jiàn guò de méi guī huā ， jiū jìng shì ān rán wú yàng ， hái shì yǐ jīng bèi yī zhǐ xiǎo yáng chī diào ， yǔ zhòu de yī qiē dōu huì yīn cǐ ér chè dǐ gǎi biàn ！
sentences.english: It is a great mystery. For you who love the little prince, as for me, nothing in the universe is the same if somewhere an unknown sheep has eaten a rose!

sentences.chinese: 请仰望星空吧。问问自己：“羊究竟吃没吃到那朵花？”你们就会看到，整个天穹的意义是如何因这个答案而瞬息万变。
sentences.pinyin: qǐng yǎng wàng xīng kōng bā 。 wèn wèn zì jǐ ： “ yáng jiū jìng chī méi chī dào nà duǒ huā ？ ” nǐ mén jiù huì kàn dào ， zhěng gè tiān qióng de yì yì shì rú hé yīn zhè gè dá àn ér shùn xī wàn biàn 。
sentences.english: Look up at the sky. Ask yourselves: "Has the sheep eaten the flower or not?" And you will see how everything changes in an instant.

sentences.chinese: 大人们永远不会理解，这究竟是一件多么重大的事情！
sentences.pinyin: dà rén mén yǒng yuǎn bù huì lǐ jiě ， zhè jiū jìng shì yī jiàn duō me zhòng dà de shì qíng ！
sentences.english: And no grown-up will ever understand that this is a matter of so much importance!
